## 2026-05-22 — Session B decisions (D21-D32 Session B)

These are the concrete shipping outcomes of the D27-D36 architecture-staging decisions. The staging decisions are the canonical record; these are the implementation detail. Compressed summaries only.

**D21(Session B) — WP style-variation overlay system retired (commit `43a93df9`).** Per-client snapshots moved to `sites/<client>/theme-snapshot.json`. Three PHP files deleted; `push-theme-snapshot.py` CLI created. `/sgs-clone` Stage 10 replaced REST POST with subprocess call to new CLI. WP theme_json filters hide Browse-styles UI. Archive: implementation detail of D28.

**D22(Session B) — Customiser migration shipped (commit `60220b13`).** Three new Customiser sections (`sgs_header` / `sgs_footer` / `sgs_site_info`). postMessage transport for colour/typography/spacing/sticky; refresh transport for conditional rules. Old admin pages preserved (not redirected). Archive: implementation detail of D35.

**D23(Session B) — Customiser paint targets: `header.wp-block-template-part` / `footer.wp-block-template-part` (commit `0ef032fe`).** Initial `.wp-site-header` / `.wp-site-footer` targeting failed — SGS template parts use `.wp-block-group` wrappers. CSS custom properties moved to `:root` for cascade availability. Archive: implementation detail of D35 (gotcha, captured in mistakes.md).

**D24(Session B) — Button-presets CSS bridge deleted (commit `60220b13`).** WP 6.9+ natively generates 100% of `--wp--custom--button-presets--*` props. `class-button-presets-admin.php` deleted. Archive: implementation detail of D30.

**D25(Session B) — View Transitions wired with WP 7.0 native + WP 6.9 inline fallback (commit `60220b13`).** `function_exists('wp_enqueue_view_transitions_admin_css')` check — calls natively on WP 7.0+, falls back to inline `@view-transition{navigation:auto;}` on WP 6.x. Archive: implementation detail of D35.

**D26(Session B) — Markup examples seeded for 73 SGS blocks (commit `d307c8b0`).** `generate-markup-examples.py` auto-generates ~56 blocks; 13 complex composites hand-authored. 69 rows in `markup_examples`. Archive: one-time seeding, not an ongoing architectural rule.

**D27(Session B) — block_supports audit found ZERO gaps; original 2:1 under-documentation prediction was wrong (commit `d307c8b0`).** Every block.json supports declaration already had a matching DB row. Archive: audit outcome, not architectural rule.

**D28(Session B) — apiVersion 3: all 69 blocks already at v3 (commit `d307c8b0`).** No bulk bump needed. 87 content-bearing attrs now carry `"role": "content"`. `wp_set_script_module_translations()` wired for 25 blocks. Archive: one-time verification outcome.

**D29(Session B) — Lucide REST migration shipped defensively (commit `d307c8b0`).** `class_exists('WP_REST_Icons_Controller')` + `function_exists('wp_register_icon_collection')` guards. `wp_register_icon_collection` does NOT exist on WP 7.0 — registration entry point unknown. `sgs_get_lucide_icon()` shim continues working. Archive: implementation detail (research pending in D34).

**D30(Session B) — Device-visibility coexistence documented (commit `d307c8b0`).** Header comment in `device-visibility.php`: WP-native preferred for simple cases; SGS extension reserved for finer-grained multi-condition controls. Archive: documentation note.

**D31(Session B) — WP 6.9.4 → 7.0 upgrade on sandybrown.** Pre-upgrade mysqldump at `~/domains/sandybrown.../sandybrown-pre-wp7.sql`. Post-upgrade API verification: key WP 7.0 functions exist. Two surprises: `wp_register_icon_collection` absent; `register_block_variation` absent. Archive: one-time ops event.

**D32(Session B) — Two-commit archive-then-delete pattern for safe class retirement.** Phase 5a Commit A moved 3 PHP picker classes to `_retired/`; Commit B (delete) deferred. Archive: process note, captured in mistakes.md.

## 2026-05-19 — Phase 9 evidence infrastructure + brand walkdown decisions

**D1(2026-05-18) — Evidence stack triple: trace + expected-rules + split-metric coverage.** Per-section `convert-trace-<boundary>.jsonl` (14 walker_branch_taken labels) + `expected-rules-<boundary>.jsonl` + `attribute_coverage` block in diff.json. Gated behind `--debug-trace`. ~5% runtime overhead OFF in production. Archive: implementation detail captured in cloning-pipeline-flow.md.

**D2(2026-05-18) — 4-rater /qc panel with Cerebras-stall replacement protocol.** When Cerebras stalls 10+ min, kill via TaskStop + dispatch Sonnet with adversarial-lens prompt. Gate's purpose is 4 INDEPENDENT lenses, not 4 specific models. Archive: operational protocol captured in QC skill.

**D3(2026-05-18) — Suffix-anchored attribute-coverage match.** Key must `endswith(suffix)` OR `endswith(suffix + breakpoint_tail)`. SGS attr naming `<slot><Property>[Breakpoint]` — bare endswith too strict; pure substring too permissive. Archive: implementation detail.

**D4(2026-05-18) — Trace lifetime discipline: try/finally reset in `convert_section`.** `finally: v3.set_trace(None, "")` guarantees clean reset. Archive: implementation detail.

**D1(2026-05-19) — Universal core-block CSS lift via `_lift_core_block_style()`.** 26-entry data-driven `_CORE_BLOCK_STYLE_MAP`. Wired into atomic_image / atomic_heading / atomic_paragraph / atomic_text_fallback. Parked for DB migration as P-CORE-STYLE-MAP-DB-MIGRATION. Archive: implementation detail captured in cloning-pipeline-flow.md.

**D2(2026-05-19) — Tag-selector blast-radius guard.** `_lift_core_block_style` skips when node has no `sgs-` class. Emits `css_decl_skipped` trace event. Archive: implementation detail, superseded by D48/D49 walker discipline.

**D3(2026-05-19) — Shallow-merge `attrs["style"]` rather than blind assignment.** `attrs["style"] = {**attrs.get("style", {}), **style_dict}`. Archive: implementation detail.

**D4(2026-05-19) — QC panel rule extension: assert file artefact existence end-to-end.** When QC artefact is a FILE, every rater MUST include "list run-dir + assert file appears + wc -l + head -1". Function-level byte-equality insufficient. Archive: captured in mistakes.md + MEMORY.md.

**D(brand-walkdown-d1) — WP-native alignment + per-client theme.json widths (surfaced 2026-05-17).** Root cause: WP `single.html` post template constrains `.entry-content` to max-width 800px while mockup HTML has no WP wrapper. Hero-clone-poc on `page.html` template with `alignfull` class renders PERFECTLY. Decision: implement widthMode attr system. Archive: implementation shipped as D(width-system); root-cause diagnosis captured.

**D(brand-walkdown-d2) — Three new dynamic SGS blocks shipped (2026-05-17).** `sgs/media` (36 attrs), `sgs/text` (79 attrs), `sgs/quote` (92 attrs). Archive: one-time block shipping event.

**D(brand-walkdown-d3) — Converter atomic-branch SGS-class guard.** `has_sgs_class` guard at top of `_lift_core_block_style`. Also skips `.sgs-brand__body p` parent-qualified selectors (parked as P-PARENT-QUALIFIED-TAG-LIFT). Archive: implementation detail, superseded by D48/D49 walker discipline.

**D(brand-walkdown-d4) — `<tag <?php echo $wrapper_attrs;` leading-space convention.** Without literal space before `<?php echo $wrapper_attrs`, WP's block-supports filter injects style attr producing malformed `<divstyle="..."`. Pattern: `<div <?php echo $wrapper_attrs; ?>>`. Swept across 6 blocks. Archive: implementation gotcha, captured in CLAUDE.md Gotchas section.

**D(brand-walkdown-d5) — `gridTemplateColumns` attr added to sgs/container.** Asymmetric grid tracks (5fr 3fr, etc.) cannot use `columns: N` which only emits `repeat(N, 1fr)`. New attrs `gridTemplateColumns` + tablet + mobile. Archive: one-time block attr addition.

**D1(2026-05-20) — Path A: site-wide variation activation (NOT per-page meta override).** Stage 10 activates variation via `set_theme_mod('active_theme_style', $slug)` site-wide. Per-page override rejected — clients get own WP install. Archive reason: explicitly marked "superseded-by-D28" in live doc; style-variation system killed 2026-05-21 (D28).

**D(a-2026-05-17) — `parse_css` regex was the single biggest recognition hole.** Old regex matched 0 of 13 `@media` blocks. Replaced with brace-balanced scanner. 13/13 media blocks captured. Archive reason: Spec 16-era implementation detail; Spec 22 walker rewrite (D79/D82) superseded all Spec 16 extraction code.

**D(c-2026-05-17) — Walker preserves SGS-BEM grouping wrappers.** Non-top-level `sgs/container` with `bem.element` set AND inner blocks → preserve as nested `sgs/container` with className. Archive reason: superseded by §FR-22-4.1 (D118) which is the canonical single rule for every sgs-classed wrapper below section root. D118 explicitly states §FR-22-4.1 supersedes D52 and related patchwork mechanisms.

**D(phase8-b) — Slot→standalone-block routing is DB-driven, not code-driven.** `slot_synonyms.standalone_block` column added; hardcoded `SLOT_TO_STANDALONE_BLOCK` dict removed. Archive reason: superseded by D99 — `slot_synonyms` table unified into new `slots` table; standalone_block routing still DB-driven (R-22-1) but now via the `slots` table, not `slot_synonyms`.

**D(spec16-2) — "CSS drives emission, never drop" (R5 re-architected).** 3-destination routing: typed-attribute lift / markup wrapper with className / attribute_gap_candidates row. Archive reason: Spec 16 CSS router superseded by Spec 22 §FR-22-3 single universal walker with 3 permitted exceptions only. D78 explicitly retired Spec 16's layered architecture.

**D(spec16-3) — sgs/container is MANDATORY at section-level, AVAILABLE elsewhere.** Auto-emission only at top-level section boundary. Nested wrappers pass through UNLESS CSS rules target them. Archive reason: superseded by §FR-22-4.1 (D118) which provides the canonical container/wrapper resolution rule for all depths.

**D(voter) — Deterministic SGS-BEM voter over probabilistic AI matcher.** Stage 1 voter does literal slug match on `.sgs-<block>` → `sgs/<block>` at confidence 1.0. Archive reason: superseded by Spec 22 R-22-2 (BEM is the only recognition signal) + D107 which retired the voter's literal-slug-match short-circuit in favour of DB-tier queries.

**D(phase5g) — Phase 5 partial closure accepted; canvas pipeline structural defect closed.** 6 of 9 blocks routed to unregistered blocks. Fix path chosen: hard gate in confidence-matrix; bucket-c-classifier + atomic-block-scaffold. +REGISTER wired. Archive reason: Spec 15 Phase 5 superseded by Spec 22 which replaced the layered pipeline architecture entirely.

**D37 — Source 2 counter gates on extraction-count, not insert-count.** `s2_extracted > 0` is canonical Mode B Source 2 health signal. Archive reason: architecture-staging Phase 4 close-out; Mode A/B multi-source extraction architecture superseded by the current single-converter (cv2-only) pipeline path.

**D38 — Source 4 calibration threshold tightened (100 → 30).** Live test: page returns 91 rows with simple HTTP fetch — below old threshold. `playwright-fetch.js` created for JS-render step. Archive reason: same as D37 — multi-source extraction architecture superseded.

**D39 — GitHub PAT format: classic `ghp_*` required for Mode B.** Fine-grained tokens returned 401 on Source 5 (GitHub API). Classic PAT with `public_repo` scope succeeds. Archive reason: Mode B GitHub Source superseded; ops detail captured in `~/.openclaw/.env` note.

**D41 — `core/group` → `sgs/container` as Stage 2 confidence-matrix fallback.** `core/group` has no SGS-BEM attributes; fallback changed to `sgs/container`. Archive reason: Stage 2 confidence-matrix fallback routing superseded by Spec 22 universal walker with DB-tier resolution (D107 retired the literal-slug-match short-circuit; D99 unified the slot lookup tables).

**D42 — Hand-authored patterns deleted; deterministic-only rule enforced.** `brand.php` + `ingredients-section.php` deleted. Pattern count: 53 (was 55). Archive reason: one-off mechanical deletion, done; rule captured in CLAUDE.md architecture rules section.

**D43 — Stage 0.7 CSS dump relocated from `theme/sgs-theme/styles/<client>.css` to `pipeline-state/<run>/variation-d0-d2.css`.** Archive reason: one-off relocation done 2026-05-23; destination path is now the canonical pipeline state path.

**D44 — Stage 10 silent-failure fix: named exit codes 4/5/6.** exit 4 (phantom page), exit 5 (id-mismatch), exit 6 (no-id-in-body). Archive reason: one-off implementation detail, done; exit codes documented in pipeline code.

**D45 — Stage 11 added: per-section pixel-diff against actual deployed page.** Stage 8 = pre-deploy autonomy gate; Stage 11 = post-deploy verification. Output: `pipeline-state/<run>/stage-11-pixel-diff.json`. Archive reason: one-off wiring done 2026-05-23; Stage 11 is now described in cloning-pipeline-stages.md.

**D46 — Walker pre-pass addresses Stage 4 emit shape, not Stage 2 match.json confidence.** `_walker_pre_pass` changes WHAT Stage 4 emits but NOT Stage 2 confidence. **D55 — `block_compositions` table merged into `patterns.block_composition` JSON column; standalone table dropped.** 35 of 37 rows ported. Archive reason: one-off data migration done 2026-05-24; `patterns.block_composition` is the current state (further evolved by D108 `block_composition` table which is distinct).

**D56 — Standalone source DBs deleted; data migrated into sgs-framework.db with `source` column.** `blocks.db` + `hooks.db` + caches deleted. ~647 MB disk recovered. Archive reason: one-off migration done 2026-05-24; single-DB architecture is now the live state captured in CLAUDE.md.

**D29(arch-staging) — INNER_BLOCK_PATTERNS dict retired; DB-backed lookup.** Hardcoded two-entry dict replaced by `blocks.parent_block` + `slot_synonyms.standalone_block` DB lookups. ## 2026-05-30 — XS-2 / XS-3 / XS-4 / XS-5 / XS-6 / D6-inheritance / D5-methodology session-close batch (D107-D113)

Session aggregate: mean pixel-diff 58.6% → 56.40% (-2.20pp) across the canary trajectory below. One walker fix shipped then reverted (D108 / D109) because of regression on featured-product (+13.07pp) and social-proof (+10.40pp). Schema and tooling work landed cleanly; walker consumption of the new shape signals is deferred to the next session with a refined trigger.

| Step | Commit | Mean pixel-diff |
|---|---|---|
| Session start (post-D93-D100 baseline) | — | 58.6% |
| Post-XS-1 (CSS sentinel fix) | 80cfc9ad | 56.85% |
| Post-XS-8/9/10 (slot-list filter + comment skip + rich-text core) | 6087594f | 56.37% |
| Post-XS-9.1+9.2 + mojibake + featured variant | b3feb9a2 + deploy | 56.47% |
| Post-D1+XS-2+XS-5 | e2c8597e | 56.39% |
| Post-XS-3 walker (REVERTED) | f173b351 | 57.71% (+1.32pp regression) |
| After revert | c76aa107 | ~56.39% |
| Post-XS-4 backfill | 04fa0f2b | 56.40% |
| Post-D6 inheritance script | 062c69d1 | n/a (no walker change) |
| **Final aggregate** | | **-2.20pp** |

**D107 — XS-2 voter literal-slug-match short-circuit retired; `blocks.tier` column + `is_section_root` flag (commit e2c8597e, ships with XS-5).** `per-section-convention-voter.py:295-305` previously returned `f"sgs/{slug_root}"` at confidence 1.0 for every `sgs-`-prefixed BEM class before consulting the DB. That short-circuit emitted phantom slugs no `block.json` registered, forcing Stage 2 fallback to `sgs/container` at confidence 0.0 across 9 of 9 boundaries on the Mama's canary. Fix shipped three coordinated changes:

1. `block.json` schema extension. Section-root blocks declare `supports.sgs.is_section_root: true`. Operator-set, not algorithm-derived (Bean rejected algorithmic detection as false-positive prone on hero). Current roster: `sgs/hero`, `sgs/cta-section`.
2. `blocks.tier` column added. `/sgs-update` Stage 1 reads `supports.sgs.is_section_root` per block.json and writes `tier='class-section'`.
3. Voter refactor at lines 295-305. For section-root BEM classes the voter queries `SELECT slug FROM blocks WHERE tier='class-section' AND slug=?` and returns the hit at confidence 0.95; for inner-div classes it excludes class-section rows. Literal-slug-match retained only as last resort, gated on a registered `block.json`.

R-22 compliance: R-22-1 (tier lives in DB), R-22-9 (universal mechanism), R-22-11 (Stage 11 pixel-diff gates the commit). Sibling parking entry P-XS-2-TIER-CRITERIA-DECISION closed.

**D108 — XS-3 / XS-6 unified `block_composition` table; walker consumption SHIPPED then REVERTED (commit f173b351 → c76aa107).** Bean's D6-expanded scope folded XS-3 (per-wrapper slot rows) and XS-6 (separate shape signals) into a single `block_composition` table. Schema: `block_slug PRIMARY KEY, wraps_block TEXT, composition_role TEXT CHECK IN ('section-root','wrapper-shell','content-block','leaf'), has_inner_blocks INTEGER, accepts_allowed_blocks TEXT`. 188 rows seeded by /sgs-update extension. Walker queries the table at Stage 5 to disambiguate multi-candidate BEM resolutions by shape before applying the FR-22-15 capability tiebreaker. Generic slot names (`products`, `cards`) never hardcode-route — routing is shape-driven (R-22-1, R-22-9).

**D109 — XS-3 walker code REVERTED (commit c76aa107) due to regression; refined trigger queued for next session.** The shipped walker condition produced +13.07pp on `sgs-featured-product` and +10.40pp on `sgs-social-proof` — aggregate +1.32pp. Root cause analysis deferred to next session. The `block_composition` DB table (188 rows) PERSISTS — schema and data are valid and reusable. Only the walker code that consumed `composition_role` was reverted. Sibling parking entry P-XS-3-TRIGGER-REFINEMENT records the next-session task: define a narrower trigger condition that excludes the two regressors.

Spec 22 implication: the new FR-22-16 / FR-22-15.1 sub-FRs documented in this session's edit-list are **DEFERRED** — they describe the intended walker consumption, not the live walker. The shape-signal data layer ships; the walker consumes it only when the refined trigger lands.

**D110 — XS-4 `assign-canonical.py` ported to post-D99 slots+roles schema; batch backfill ran cleanly (commit 04fa0f2b + follow-ups 52408c7e).** Old script queried the dropped `slot_synonyms` table; 9 references migrated to `slots WHERE scope='element'` + `roles` table. Dry-run + apply ran without errors. Coverage on `block_attributes.canonical_slot` rose from 52/2074 (2.5%) to 659/2074 (31.8%) at initial backfill, then to 692/2074 (33.4%) after XS-4 follow-ups (camelCase regex + slot vocab + Tier B2 compound selectors); `role` from 110/2074 (5.3%) to 676/2074 (32.6%) initial, then to 689/2074 (33.2%) post-follow-ups. ~1382 rows remain NULL — gap candidates for future enrichment. Predicted vs actual delta: predicted 80–90% coverage; actual 33.4% because slots.aliases lookup is conservative and most attrs lack canonical-vocabulary aliases. The expansion is real; the high-end estimate was inflated.

## 2026-05-30 — XS-1 / XS-8 / XS-9 / XS-10 mechanical cv2 fixes; XS-11 retracted as subagent false positive (D102-D106)

**D102 — XS-1 CSS serialiser sentinel leak (`'@media ... :: .selector'` → proper @media nesting).** `_parse_css()` at convert.py:352 flattens nested @media rules into dict keys with `' :: '` internal sentinel. `collect_css_for_classes` at line 417 emitted these keys verbatim into inline `<style>` blocks, producing invalid CSS browsers refused. Fix: detect sentinel + reconstruct `@media (...) { .selector { ... } }`. Empirical: 57.96% → 56.85% mean (-1.11pp), 19 → 0 sentinel leaks in extract.json, sgs-featured-product -9.00pp (the only large win because most sections target wrappers that don't render — XS-3 gating). Commit `80cfc9ad`.

**D103 — XS-8 leftover-bucket noise filter (Stage 9 extraction_failed).** `route_extraction_failed()` enumerated every Stage 3 declared slot as "extraction_failed" when not filled, producing ~69 noise entries per section (sgs/container's 69 default-bearing attrs) drowning real defects. Fix: skip emission when both `attribute_role == 'auto-derived'` AND `default not in {None, '', []}`. Empirical: leftover-bucket extraction_failed 723 → 387 (-336 entries, -46%), 0pp pixel-diff (observability only). Commit `6087594f`.

**D104 — XS-9 rich-text preservation in core/* atomic-tag swaps + XSS hardening.** `_atomic_attrs_for` used `node.get_text(strip=True)` collapsing inline tags (`<br>`, `<strong>`, `<a>`). New `_rich_text_content` helper preserves bounded inline-tag allowlist for core/heading / core/paragraph / core/quote / core/button. **SGS atomic emissions (sgs/heading, sgs/text, sgs/button, sgs/quote) retain get_text behaviour pending render.php audit** — parked at P-SGS-ATOMIC-RICH-TEXT-AUDIT. XSS hardening: HTML-escape text nodes, scheme-allowlist `<a href>` ({http, https, mailto, tel, relative}), attribute-escape href value, drop all other attrs. Empirical: 0pp impact on Mama's canary because hero H1 routes via sgs/heading (excluded by conservative scope), not core/heading. Architecturally correct + benefits future core/* mockups. Commit `fec91c5d`.

**D105 — XS-10 walker skips bs4 Comment before NavigableString check.** HTML comments (`<!-- Main product -->`) leaked as bare text because `Comment` is subclass of `NavigableString`; the walker's Exception 0 matched Comment via NavigableString branch and emitted `str(node).strip()` (the comment's inner text). Fix: explicit Comment check returning None placed BEFORE NavigableString branch. Empirical: sgs-featured-product -5.47pp (the only section with HTML comments in mockup). Commit `943e52b2`.

**D106 — XS-11 RETRACTED: subagent false positive on emoji mojibake.** Gift-section subagent in 2026-05-30 diagnostic register claimed `🏥` → `🏥` mojibake in extract.json. Byte-level verification proved otherwise: raw bytes `\xf0\x9f\x8f\xa5` = correct UTF-8 encoding of U+1F3E5. The subagent saw mojibake-shaped text in its tool output because its rendering environment misinterpreted UTF-8 as cp1252; the file itself is correctly encoded. sgs-clone-orchestrator.py + convert.py file reads already use `encoding="utf-8"` explicitly. New captured lesson: `feedback_subagent_evidence_must_be_byte_verified_for_encoding.md` — any encoding-related defect claim from a subagent must be byte-verified via `open(p, 'rb').read()` + `.hex()` before treating as a real bug. R-22-11 extension: "verify rendered output, not internal metrics" extends to "verify the bytes, not the rendering of the bytes."

**Empirical lesson from XS-1 + XS-8 + XS-9 + XS-10 measurement cycle:** subagent fix-shape predictions (range -15 to -30pp aggregate) overshot real impact by ~10× (actual aggregate -1.59pp from 57.96% to 56.37%). Per blub.db 276 council-predictions-need-empirical-validation: fix-shapes are HYPOTHESES, not specs; predicted impact must be empirically measured. Going forward: each fix-cycle records pre/post + predicted vs actual ratio for calibration accumulation. After 5-7 calibration points the ratio will inform future predictions.

**Per-section pixel-diff noise floor observed:** sgs-social-proof showed +2.04pp delta from XS-8/9/10 measurement run even though block_markup is byte-identical pre/post. Confirms inherent per-section pixel-diff variability of ~±2pp from font rendering / screenshot timing / browser state. Future fix-cycles must interpret per-section deltas with this noise floor when isolating impact.

## 2026-05-29 — slot_synonyms + legacy_role_lookup unified into `slots`; new `roles` table; html_tag_to_core_block INSERT OR REPLACE; property_suffixes.kind_override (D99)

**D99 — slot_synonyms + legacy_role_lookup unified into new `slots` table; new `roles` table replaces slot_synonyms.role_classification; html_tag_to_core_block seed switched to INSERT OR REPLACE; property_suffixes.kind_override column replaces _KIND_BY_SUFFIX hardcoded dict.**

Four DB-driven cleanups in one atomic migration (`2026-05-29-d99-db-unification.py`). All honour R-22-1 (DB-first, no hardcoded dicts).

**Fix 1 — `slots` table (105 rows, replaces slot_synonyms 89 + legacy_role_lookup 16).** PK is `(slot_name, scope)` composite — required because the same name can exist at both scopes (`header` is element-scope identity slot in slot_synonyms AND section-scope class in legacy_role_lookup). `scope='element'` rows = former slot_synonyms; `scope='section'` rows = former legacy_role_lookup. `html_semantic_tag` column NOT migrated (was only 27/89 populated; `atomic_tag_map()` never consulted it; `html_tag_for_slot()` now returns None). Consumer updates: `db_lookup._slot_synonyms()` → `SELECT slot_name, aliases FROM slots WHERE scope='element'`; `_slot_to_standalone_block()` → same table; `_slot_alias_to_standalone()` → same; `legacy_role_lookup_for()` / `_load_legacy_role_cache()` → `SELECT slot_name, standalone_block FROM slots WHERE scope='section'`; `sgs-update-v2.py` Stage 5 → `SELECT rowid, slot_name FROM slots WHERE scope='element'` + `UPDATE slots SET standalone_block=? WHERE rowid=? AND scope='element'`. Old tables `slot_synonyms` and `legacy_role_lookup` DROPPED after count verification (element=89, section=16). Both DBs (`.claude` + `.agents`) migrated.

**Fix 2 — `roles` table (20 rows, replaces slot_synonyms.role_classification).** This closes the link-href bug: `_content_bearing_roles()` was querying `SELECT DISTINCT role FROM slot_synonyms WHERE role_classification='content-bearing'`, which returned only 4 roles because no slot_synonyms row had `role='link-href'` — the migration that seeded the column only UPDATEd existing rows. The `roles` table is seeded from `_ROLE_CLASSIFICATION_MAP` (20 entries defined by role name, not derived from slot rows) via `INSERT OR REPLACE`. After D99, `_content_bearing_roles()` returns 5 roles (adding link-href) and `equivalent_block_for('sgs/media', 'videoUrl')` correctly returns `'sgs/media'` (was None). `_styling_behaviour_roles()` returns 15. Schema: `(role_name TEXT PK, classification TEXT CHECK('content-bearing'|'styling-behaviour'|'unclassified'))`. `_migrate_roles_table()` runs at module load; INSERT OR REPLACE ensures seed-dict updates propagate (not OR IGNORE).

**Fix 3 — html_tag_to_core_block seed: INSERT OR IGNORE → INSERT OR REPLACE.** db_lookup.py line change only. Prevents seed-dict/DB divergence when `_HTML_TAG_TO_CORE_BLOCK_SEED` entries are updated — DB picks up changes on next module load without manual row edits.

**Fix 4 — property_suffixes.kind_override column (17 rows seeded).** `_KIND_BY_SUFFIX` dict (17 entries: LineHeight, LetterSpacing, FontFamily … Alignment) was a hardcoded Python lookup. Now seeded into `property_suffixes.kind_override` via idempotent `_migrate_property_suffixes_kind_override()` at module load. `_kind_for()` queries `kind_override` column first (R-22-1 DB-first); falls through to role-based inference for uncovered suffixes. `UPDATE WHERE kind_override IS NULL` preserves manual overrides. `_KIND_BY_SUFFIX` dict retained in code as seed source.

Migration script: `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/migrations/2026-05-29-d99-db-unification.py` (idempotent, applies to both DBs, verifies counts before DROPs, uses explicit `BEGIN`/`COMMIT` to wrap DDL in one transaction).
Status: active

## 2026-05-29 — Stage 10 prune-mode default → aggressive + attr-level orphan detection

**D94 — Two changes to `sgs-update-v2.py` Stage 10 (`prune_orphans`).**

**Change 1 — `--prune-mode` default flipped to `aggressive`.** Previously `mark-stale` (set `is_stale=1`) was the default; now `aggressive` (DELETE) is the default. Reasoning: `block.json` is the source of truth; a support that is no longer declared in `block.json` would be re-INSERTed by Stage 1 if the block returns, so marking it stale rather than deleting it just creates permanent clutter. Conservative mode is now opt-in via `--prune-mode conservative`. Legacy CLI alias `mark-stale` maps to `conservative` internally. Result: the 26 pre-existing `is_stale=1` rows (from 4 retired blocks — `sgs/back-to-top`, `sgs/data-display`, `sgs/icon-block`, `sgs/reading-progress` — all with `block.json` absent from disk) were deleted on first aggressive run. Post-run `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block_supports WHERE is_stale=1` = 0.

**Change 2 — Attr-level orphan detection added to Stage 10.** Previously Stage 10 only caught block-level orphans (block_slug absent from `blocks` table). It missed the case where the block exists in `blocks` but a specific `attr_name` was removed from `block.json` (Stage 1 only INSERTs/UPDATEs attrs, never removes them). Fix: `_prune_orphans_on_conn` now builds a `live_attrs` map (`slug → frozenset[attr_names]`) from the current block.json scan and walks all SGS `block_attributes` rows whose `block_slug` is in the `blocks` table. Rows where `attr_name` is absent from `live_attrs[block_slug]` are deleted. Also handles the edge case where a block is in the `blocks` table but has no `block.json` on disk (all its attrs are ghost rows). `block_attributes` has no `is_stale` column, so conservative mode is a no-op here (a warning is printed but rows are still deleted — no alternative). New result-dict key: `orphan_attributes_deleted_attr_level` (distinct from `orphan_attributes_deleted` which is block-level). Live run deleted 205 ghost attr rows. Idempotency confirmed (all counters 0 on second run).

**Stale-supports detection scope fix (discovered during implementation):** The stale-supports check was previously gated on `b_slug in live_supports`, which silently skipped blocks that are in the `blocks` table but have no `block.json` on disk. These blocks' supports were perpetually is_stale=1 but never deleted. Fix: check `b_slug not in live_supports` as an additional match condition (all their supports are stale). Same fix applied to attr-level orphan detection for the same edge case.

Status: active

## 2026-05-27 — Spec 22 Phase 0.1 /qc-council findings + role-exclusion fix + Tier C deletion + pixel-diff measurement methodology

**D85 — Role-exclusion positive-allowlist closes FR-22-2.2 NULL-role hole.** /qc-council Task 2 Rater A's adversarial 5th unit test caught a real bug: `equivalent_block_for('sgs/cta-section', 'textTransform')` returned 'sgs/text' when it should return None. Root cause: `db_lookup.py:839` was `if role and role in _ROLE_EXCLUSION_ALLOWLIST: return None` — short-circuits on falsy role. DB audit confirmed 171 rows have content-bearing `canonical_slot` + `role IS NULL`; 3 confirmed misroutes (`sgs/cta-section.textTransform`, `sgs/hero.textTransform`, `sgs/info-box.textTransform` all canonical_slot='text'). This is the exact FR-22-2.2 "typography looks like heading" trap the spec was designed to prevent — the role-exclusion gate had a hole. Fix: positive-allowlist (`if role not in _CONTENT_BEARING_ROLES: return None`) — content routes via block-equivalence ONLY when role is explicitly in the content-bearing set; role-NULL defaults to scalar (styling-safe). Five unit tests now PASS including the adversarial case. Side-effect: the 4 already-applied Tier B rows (sgs/icon.iconSource/iconName/linkTarget + sgs/timeline.entries) have correct canonical_slot but role=NULL → walker won't activate them until role-detection backfill lands (P-SGS-UPDATE-ROLE-DETECTION-IMPROVE, dispatched Wave A 2026-05-27). The DB state is correct + preparatory; walker activation is deliberate-gated on role enrichment.

**D86 — Tier C deleted from equivalent_block_for(); Spec 22 amended to 2-tier system.** Bean directive 2026-05-27 after /qc-council Task 2 Rater B verdict (DELETE-NOW). Tier C in `db_lookup.py:761-796` + `:859-865` was 40+ LoC of untested code with 0 inputs in current DB state. Risks Rater B flagged: bit-rot, future maintainer "fixing" the dormant warning without understanding why it was dormant, hardcoded frozenset violating R-22-1. Counter-view (preserves spec symmetry) overruled: Tier C will re-add with empirical evidence when P-SGS-UPDATE-ROLE-DETECTION-IMPROVE generates real Tier C inputs. Re-add carries DB-derived role classification + unit tests against real data. Spec 22 §FR-22-2.1 amended from 3-tier to 2-tier (Tier A direct join + Tier B BEM-element). §FR-22-2.3 (Tier C uses existing slot_synonyms) marked obsolete. §10 F-PE-5 + §15 F-AP-2 / F-SC-11 marked RESOLVED via deletion. Wave A Sonnet 2 executes the deletion + spec amendment.

**D87 — pixel-diff.py architectural divergence from Spec 22 §7 Commit 0.3 wording.** Spec wording said "detect chrome at top of SGS screenshot, crop before comparison". /qc-council Task 5 Rater B confirmed the empirical falsification: cropping made the score WORSE (57% > 54.5% pre-fix baseline). The actual mitigation that shipped: `visibility:hidden` on detected `position:sticky;top:0` template-part header BEFORE `el.screenshot()`, NOT post-screenshot crop. Mechanism: sticky chrome re-anchors to viewport-top during `el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()` and paints over the captured element. The cream-coloured chrome band on the saved PNG is `tph_bottom − target_viewport_offset` (66px at 1440) NOT the full chrome height (247px). Post-screenshot crop-by-chrome-height over-cropped by the difference. Empirical result: hero-clone-poc 1440 went 54.5% → 10.3% (−44.2pp); Mama's hero 1440 IMPROVED 69.6% → 60.8% (−8.8pp; honest new baseline since chrome was contaminating prior measurement). Rater B verdict: DIVERGENCE JUSTIFIED — UPDATE SPEC. Spec 22 §7 Commit 0.3 wording amended in this commit. The R-22-7 binding rule (council fix-shapes are hypotheses) was honoured: the spec-literal approach was tried, measured, falsified, then revised.

**D88 — pixel-diff.py brand-375 +2.4pp is REAL methodology shift, NOT flake.** /qc-council Task 5 Rater A correction. Three byte-identical-PNG re-runs (`md5(sgs.png)` matched across `mamas-brand-375-no-wait-fonts`, `mamas-brand-375-rerun`, `mamas-section_sgs-brand-375x812`) confirmed determinism. The +2.4pp delta from 53.225% → 55.619% is a measurement-method-driven change (visibility:hidden of 83px sticky chrome on brand-375 alters layout-rearrangement bleed into the cropped region). Parking entry P-G4-MEASUREMENT-DECONTAMINATION transition wording updated accordingly: "+2.4pp on brand-375 is methodology shift, not flake". Implication: every chrome-affected Mama's cell is partially stale on the 2026-05-26 mean 63.0% baseline. Wave B re-captures the full Mama's baseline with new pixel-diff.py.

## 2026-05-27 — Spec 22 Phase 0.1 scope correction

**D84 — Phase 0.1 scope corrected from "backfill 1,214 NULL canonical_slot rows" to "backfill ≤72 Tier B derived_selector candidates."** Empirical DB audit 2026-05-27 (verified by parallel queries against `sgs-framework.db`): of 1,214 rows with `canonical_slot IS NULL`, 1,142 (94%) are triple-NULL (canonical_slot + derived_selector + role all NULL) and are **correctly NULL by design** — behavioural / sizing / styling / enum / identity attrs catalogued in `block_attributes` (the table catalogues every block × every attr; `canonical_slot` is sparsely populated by intent, not gap). 72 rows (6%) have `derived_selector` set and are the actual Tier B backfill candidates. 0 rows have `role` set without `derived_selector` (Tier C dormant — wired for future-proofing per Spec 22 §FR-22-2.1 but has no inputs to act on today). Sample triple-NULL rows confirm the pattern: `back-to-top.position`, `reading-progress.wpm`, `icon.size` — content-NULL by design, not by gap.

Phase 0.1 script guardrail added: `assign-canonical.py` MUST refuse to operate on any row where `derived_selector IS NULL` (structural input filter; not optional). This makes the F-RA-1 "mis-tag behavioural attr as block-equivalent" failure mode **impossible by input shape**, not by regression test. F-RA-1 mitigation downgraded from "golden corpus regression test" to "structural guardrail + dry-run JSON diff + Bean inline review" — risk surface reduced from 1,214 rows to ≤72 reviewable rows (one screen of JSON). Golden corpus (`.claude/specs/22-golden-corpus.json`) and F-RA-9 mitigation both DROPPED — the dry-run diff IS the review surface; a hand-authored corpus would test a category-error premise.

Spec 22 §FR-22-2.1 empirical-state framing rewritten in same commit. §10 F-RA-1 row downgraded. §11 success criteria adds "≤72-row Tier B diff reviewed + applied; 1,142 triple-NULL rows verified unchanged" bullet. §7 Commit 0.1 rewritten. Phase 1 plan Phase 0.1 row rewritten (estimate 3h → 1.5h). Next-session-prompt Task 1 DROPPED, Task 2 rescoped.

Lesson captured at `~/.claude/projects/c--Users-Bean-Projects-small-giants-wp/memory/feedback_grep_verify_handoff_diagnostic_premises.md` continues to apply — the next-session-prompt + Spec 22 empirical-state section both carried a category-error framing (treating sparse-by-design as gap) until DB audit pressure-tested it. Sibling rule: R-22-8 (schema enumeration before "missing X" claim) — when an empirical-state count is load-bearing for a downstream action (script extension, Sonnet brief, council finding mitigation), the count itself is subject to the same gate as the action.

_D114/D115/D116 superseded by D118 (FR-22-4.1), D117 (content-routing shipped), and Spec 27 (D161, absorbed Spec 24) respectively. D133 self-flagged superseded by D134/D135 (variant detection shipped). Verbatim below._

**D114 — XS-3 reconciled: Spec 23 branch merged to main (eeac99a1).** The "two competing XS-3" framing was wrong — `git merge-base main eced119b == 0a212e3c`, so the branch was a strict SUPERSET of main's XS-3, not a rival. Clean head-to-head on page 144 (same baseline, OPcache reset between): main XS-3 alone 58.39% vs branch (XS-3+B2/B3+A1) 58.98% (+0.59pp). The featured-product 768 "+19.7pp" was a vertical-anchor crop artefact between two equally-EMPTY renders. Bean approved merge to keep Spec 23 momentum; marginal cost is hybrid-content noise, not layout. (Supersedes the never-written "D114" referenced in eced119b's commit message.)

**D115 — FR-22-6 hybrid problem is FRACTAL; root cause = walker never runs FR-22-2.** featured-product + social-proof render EMPTY on the live page (verified: live DOM textLen=0, NOT the pixel-diff which showed a FALSE −30.9pp win — empty section = shorter crop = more matching background; see memory `empty-section-false-pixel-diff-win`). Container blocks (product-card/testimonial/testimonial-slider) were migrated to echo $content (WIP commit c9c6544d on `feat/fr22-6-content-render`) — necessary but NOT sufficient. Investigation (opus subagent, read-only) found the real defect: the walker (`convert.py`) resolves nodes + recurses but **never calls `equivalent_block_for()`/`array_item_slot_for()`/`lift_behavioural_attrs()`** (the FR-22-2 content-routing layer). Three symptoms: (1) `sgs-product-card__body` mis-resolves to the `sgs/text` LEAF because the `slots` table lists `body/intro/description` as `text`-slot aliases — the walker then nests heading/price/pills inside the leaf, which ignores its children → swallowed; (2) leaf text emitted as inner markup, not into the scalar `text` attr → `sgs/text`/`sgs/label` render empty; (3) array items (packSizes) never emitted. **Fix is CONVERTER-side (1-2 files, G1-G4), NOT a 61-block migration** — leaf blocks STAY leaves (R-22-14). **XS-3 must be EXTENDED, not closed**: its guard only fires on slug=None, so it never catches a wrapper that mis-resolves to a leaf (this is why "recent work should have fixed container routing" didn't — the blind spot is leaf-misresolution). Pills must route to `sgs/button` (interactive), NOT `sgs/label` (eyebrow). Phase plan: `plans/2026-05-31-converter-content-routing-fix.md`. Deferred to a focused next session per STOP #19 (sensitive sequential converter work, not iterated inline at session tail).

**D116 — Spec 24 (Query-Driven Content Cards) drafted + product CPT Phase A foundation built.** Research (research-buddies + library-docs, blub.db): presentational-vs-query is a FALSE fork — build ONE dual-mode card (typed OR CPT-bound) on a custom CPT + core Query Loop + Block Bindings API. **Custom CPT, NOT WooCommerce** (maintenance tax unjustified for marketing sites), NOT both. Same engine generalises to testimonials/team/case-studies = highest-leverage framework primitive. `sgs_product` CPT + 2-product seed built (committed; not yet deployed). Spec `specs/24-QUERY-DRIVEN-CONTENT-CARDS.md`. Card dual-mode binding gated on the converter fix (FR-24-9).

**D133 — Universal variant detection (Spec 22 §FR-22-20) specced; the hero `$is_split` fix CONCEDED as a cheat, flagged for reversal (Bean-directed).** Bean rejected the 2026-06-01 hero `$is_split = ('split'===$variant) || !empty($split_image)` fix as a per-block cheat: not universal, and mis-fires on stale data (a block carrying both standard + split attrs from prior edits would be mis-detected). The proper fix chooses the variant from **what the draft pulled THIS run** (the extract), not the block's stored attrs, universally for all 33 variant-bearing blocks (hero/product-card/gallery/mobile-nav/…). Mechanism (§FR-22-20): blocks declare `supports.sgs.variants` (variant → its attrs/slots) in block.json + a new `blocks.variant_attr` column; `/sgs-update` populates a new `variant_slots` table (each variant's DISCRIMINATING slots via set-difference, excluding shared attrs); the converter counts which variant's `variant_slots` were extracted from the draft, picks the highest count (insurance tie-break), sets the variant attr. render.php's ORIGINAL variant gate then works → the `$is_split` band-aid is REVERTED. DB-driven (R-22-1), universal (R-22-9), draft-data-driven (closes the stale-data hole), drafts stay variant-unaware (free-form, not limited to current design capacity). Scaffolding partly exists (33 variant-selector enum attrs + the `variations` table, 206 rows); the new piece is the discriminating-slot map. **BUILD = next session's opening task** (DB schema → block.json declaration → /sgs-update population → converter detector → revert $is_split → re-clone+verify → generalise to the other 32 variant blocks). **→ SHIPPED for hero (Commits 1–5 of 6) + LIVE-DOM verified — see D134/D135. Commit 6 (modifier-class→enum path) redesign-pending per D135.**

- **`sgs_header` CPT gained a `template` key** (`'template' => [['sgs/site-header']]`) in `class-sgs-block-cpts.php` — this was previously absent (confirmed live code had no `template` key at all, so this is an ADD not a swap, matching the FR-S3-4 addendum's fact-check). Footer template deferred to P3.
- **Confirmed the header is genuinely block-based in the Site Editor** (not a Customiser-driven builder — the WordPress Customiser is legacy tooling for classic themes; this is a block theme, so the Site Editor + template parts + blocks is the correct and only mechanism, consistent with §S1's architecture).
- **PROVEN root cause of the stray WooCommerce mini-cart + customer-account in the header:** WooCommerce auto-injects `woocommerce/mini-cart` and `woocommerce/customer-account` after ANY `core/navigation` block via the WP Block Hooks API. Verified directly in WooCommerce source: `src/Blocks/BlockTypes/MiniCart.php` and `CustomerAccount.php` both register `'anchor' => 'core/navigation'` via `add_filter('hooked_block_types', ..., 9)`; the `BlockHooksTrait.php` docblock confirms the mechanism. This is not an inferred cause — it's read directly off the hooking code.
- **Bean's decision: fix via architecture, not a workaround filter.** A `hooked_block_types` suppressor filter was built and validated as functionally working, then REVERTED per Bean — the correct closure is P2 (`sgs/adaptive-nav`, FR-S9-4) replacing `core/navigation` in the header, so WooCommerce has no `core/navigation` anchor left to hook onto and the injection stops by construction. Documented as the "ROOT FIX" note on FR-S9-4 in Spec 17 §S9 and in `.claude/plans/2026-07-13-header-builder-remaining-work.md`.
- **NEXT:** P2 `sgs/adaptive-nav` — both the scoped nav block AND the architectural fix for the WC Block-Hooks injection. Once it ships, remove the interim nav-visibility CSS hack in `sgs/site-header/style.css`.

## 2026-07-13 — D323: Header/Footer/Nav SYSTEM design-gate APPROVED + P0 drawer-fix SHIPPED + 6-doc rollout

**D319 — the extractor palette is now additive by construction; the D318 palette-rename regression is fixed.** Branch `main`. Bean caught it live: after the D318 deploy, sections with `surface-pink` background (hero band, trust bar, gift section) + the gift-card labels went CREAM.

- **Cause (proven on the live DOM):** the D318 palette generator renamed `surface-pink`→`custom-surface-pink` (my `custom-` prefix for any non-baseline-slug colour) AND dropped declared tokens it saw no resting usage for (`success`/`cookie-brown`/`accent-dark`) AND its generated palette was a SUBSET missing hand-added colours the draft can't provide (`surface-peach`/warm-axis/`footer-bg`/`client-*` aliases). The already-cloned blocks reference `var(--wp--preset--color--surface-pink)` (baked into their markup) → now UNDEFINED → transparent → cream. Live probe: `--…--surface-pink` = `rgba(0,0,0,0)`, my `custom-surface-pink` defined but unreferenced. **This VIOLATED my own FR-33-11** ("NO snapshot-only push of a regenerated palette to a client whose pages aren't re-cloned in the same change").
- **Fix (Bean-directed "add the customs, don't ruin the palette; reclone fixes the new setup"):** (1) `palette.py` — a client colour keeps its OWN draft-token name as the slug (`surface-pink`, never `custom-`/dropped); EVERY declared solid `:root` colour is emitted (usage only informs the ROLE, never whether to emit). (2) `extract.py --merge-onto <existing>` — ADDITIVELY merges the generated globals/base onto an existing client snapshot: generated wins on shared slugs (carries the drift fix), but every existing slug the draft can't provide is PRESERVED + component `styles.css`/pattern refs carried forward. Non-destructive by construction.
- **LANDED live (sandybrown page 8):** all pink restored (hero/trust/gift/labels = `rgb(245,194,200)`); surface-pink + surface-peach + all 21 slugs defined; base 16px; h2 lh 1.2; primary coral, secondary transparent; 0 console errors. 18 tests (2 new guards: raw-name-not-custom + additive-merge-preserves-extras). **Architectural rule:** a regenerated palette is NEVER a straight replace on an already-cloned site — it is additive + gated by a reclone (FR-33-11/12). Lesson `feedback_extractor_palette_must_be_additive_not_destructive_replace`.

## 2026-07-12 — D312: per-block `<style>`-tag consolidation SHIPPED + LANDED (P-STYLE-TAG-CONSOLIDATION)

**D312 — the ~100 per-block scoped `<style>` tags (~33KB, page 8) are consolidated into ONE head stylesheet, operator-selectable file vs inline.** Branch `main`, commits `9dfcaa6e` (design + Spec 32 v1.2/FR-32-11) + `72c0387a` (collector) + `c30dd5e2` (final modes + settings), all pushed. Full research + `/qc-council` GO-WITH-FIXES trail. Canonical: Spec 32 §6.2.

- **Collector = one `render_block` chokepoint**, NOT ~60 per-block emit-site edits. A late (`priority 99`) filter lifts every `sgs/*` block's `<style>` out of its rendered HTML into a per-request buffer (dedup by content hash; D303 residual-last order preserved). Captures all 6 emit shapes the council found (incl. the container wrapper's prepended tag + `custom-css.php`'s appended residual) without touching either file; universal (R-31-9). Dissolves the "6-shapes audit" risk the council flagged.
- **Delivery = ONE output buffer** (`template_redirect`) injects the consolidated CSS into the `<head>` (before `</head>`, after block `style.css` → overrides win) on EVERY front-end render → self-consistent under full-page caching (no pointer, no cold/warm, no freeze). **Two modes** (SGS → CSS Output settings, `sgs_css_output_mode`, default `file`): `file` = cached content-hashed external `<link>` (immutable `Cache-Control` .htaccess, atomic tmp+rename, epoch-invalidated on save_post/template/global-styles/deploy + `litespeed_purge_all` + GC; an optimisation plugin defers it); `head` = inline `<style>` in head (the draft's own model), self-contained. Settings page lists LiteSpeed/Autoptimize/WP Rocket/Perfmatters + the exact setting.
- **Key build finding (Bean-directed test):** the initially-designed generate-then-serve external-file model was **reproduced FAILING live under the LiteSpeed page cache** (froze the cold inline response — exactly the council's prediction) → replaced by the unified buffer. First verified **no LiteSpeed Cache plugin was installed** (only sgs-blocks+woocommerce), then installed it on the canary to test file mode. Research (web.dev 14KB rule + "LiteSpeed optimises external not inline") corrected a hasty inline-in-head lean. Memory: `test-with-actual-cache-layer-and-self-consistent-render`.
- **Editor parity (live-verified):** frontend-only gate `! is_admin() && ! wp_is_serving_rest_request()` — block-renderer REST (`context=edit`) keeps the block `<style>` inline; naive `! is_admin()` would have unstyled 8 ServerSideRender blocks in the editor.
- **LANDED (sandybrown page 8, both modes, incl. under LiteSpeed):** 1 head style/link, 0 body `<style>`, correct cascade + computed values 375/768/1440, D303 intact, 0 console errors, settings page renders. Render-side PHP only (no converter/JS; conformance goldens unaffected); no block version bump.

ROOT CAUSE (computed-style proven, /systematic-debugging): **WooCommerce's product-panel CSS applies `float:left;width:150px;margin-left:-150px;display:block` to EVERY `<label>` in the panel — PANEL-WIDE, not just `p.form-field` rows** — it is designed for the single left-column field label; any ADDITIONAL nested label (per radio/checkbox/input) collapses onto the same 150px column. The D200 design rater HAD flagged this as "crowding/not WC two-column" and it was mis-filed as deferred polish — measurement-vs-eye rule honoured: Bean's report stood, the measurement set was extended (bounding-rect overlap counting), the defect confirmed at every viewport. FIXES (2 parallel sonnet fixers + orchestrator): (1) inline resets `float:none;width:auto;margin:…` on every nested label (WC's rule carries no !important — inline wins; note float blockifies display, and WC's width/margin hit FLEX ITEMS too even though flex ignores float); (2) the "Manual price overrides" SECTION label needed the reset too — its div lacks the 150px column padding so WC's negative margin clipped it off the left edge (the fixer's claim that the rule wouldn't target it was WRONG — live computed styles settled it); (3) the Wave-2 attestation row (`woocommerce_wp_checkbox`) is a DIFFERENT mechanism — its legally-worded label was simply too long for WC's column; WC-idiomatic fix: short column label ("Single-unit price is genuine"), the full first-person confirmation moved to the description beside the checkbox (legal meaning preserved; tick still confirms it). Live-verified: 0 overlapping label pairs across all 3 groups; attestation 24px single-line (was 72px); panel-wide clipped-label sweep = zero. ROUND-2 (Bean R-22-13, same day, `ffadce85`): two more WC-panel float mechanisms live-measured + fixed — (4) a HALF-WIDTH `form-row-first` wrapper with no `form-row-last` partner lets the NEXT row float up beside it (the pounds field's help-tip painted onto the attestation label); rows in this panel stay `form-row-full` unless deliberately paired. (5) WC FLOATS the panel's selects/inputs too — a `display:block` description after a floated `width:100%` select stays on the SAME line with its text wrapping around the float ("Which" orphan); bound the select (400px/max-width:100%) AND give the description `clear:both`. LESSON: any hand-rolled markup inside the WC product panel must assume EVERY label gets column treatment — reset nested labels explicitly, and keep `woocommerce_wp_*` field labels SHORT (sentences go in description).

**D145 — Converter carries `is-style-*` block styles onto cloned blocks + content-leaf ladder made tag-authoritative (CLONING thread; commit `b93a3b51`).** _[Documented from the commit during the 2026-06-01 doc-sweep — cloning thread to ratify.]_ Enables a Trustpilot-style review bar (and any styled block) to clone fully. **(1) is-style preservation:** a draft can request a registered block STYLE on a recognised block (e.g. `<div class="sgs-x__stars is-style-trustpilot" data-sgs-rating="5">` → `sgs/star-rating` with the Trustpilot-green preset). `walk()` now carries any `is-style-*` class from the source node onto the emitted block's className (resolved-block path + top-level wrap); rating lifts via the existing `lift_behavioural_attrs` `data-sgs-*` path. **(2) content-leaf ladder reordered to tag-authoritative:** the node's OWN tag (`atomic_tag_map`) routes FIRST + ungated (img→sgs/media{src,alt}, p→text, h*→heading, a→core/button, blockquote→sgs/quote), THEN text-capable BEM segment, THEN sgs/text — fixes an sgs-classed `<img>` (the Trustpilot logo) that previously mis-routed to sgs/text instead of sgs/media. Unit-verified: logo `<img>`→sgs/media; stars div→sgs/star-rating{rating,className:is-style-trustpilot}; CTA span→sgs/text; prior committed-D regressions unchanged. Cross-model qc-council PASS (1 intentional nit: `<a>` text-label → core/button by tag-authority — correct for SGS-BEM drafts, not a regression). R-22-1/3/9 clean. Builds on D141's §FR-22-4.1 content-leaf step.

## 2026-06-01 (theme thread) — Mobile-nav full-fix (D143) + product-card 6 decisions ratified (D144)

**D143 — Mobile-nav fully fixed: full-screen overlay + populated menu + header-only inserter (SGS THEME thread; commit `1f985c9a`).** Bean reported the mobile nav opened to a tiny box, showed no menu, and couldn't be closed. Root-caused live (CDP `use_browser` on canary, 375px, logged-out) per the root-cause methodology, then fixed in 4 parts — all live-verified: **(1) Overlay sizing** — the `--overlay` variant never overrode the Popover API UA defaults (`width/height:fit-content`) so it opened at 208×158; added `width:100vw + height:100vh/100dvh + inset:0` (style.css, overlay rule only; slide/bottom-sheet untouched) → fills viewport 375×812. **(2) Block-gap strip** — WP flow-layout `:root :where(.is-layout-flow) > * { margin-block-start:16px }` (specificity 0,1,0) tied the base `.sgs-mobile-nav{margin:0}` and won on source order, exposing a 16px strip above the drawer; the doubled block class `.sgs-mobile-nav.wp-block-sgs-mobile-nav` (0,2,0) beats it → flush at y:0. **(3) Empty menu [universal bug]** — `render_menu_items()` only handled `core/navigation-link`/`-submenu`, but WP's DEFAULT nav content is `<!-- wp:page-list /-->` (ground-truthed: canary `parts/header.html` nav is self-closing → falls back to `wp_navigation` post 4 = bare page-list). Added a `core/page-list` case (`class-mobile-nav-renderer.php`) expanding the published page hierarchy (top-level links + one accordion level for pages-with-children) via new shared helpers `render_link_li()` + `build_submenu_li()`. Universal — fixes every site whose header nav isn't manually populated (incl. the framework-default header per Spec 17 §S1). Verified **0 → 13 items** + link navigation (clicked "Hero Clone PoC" → landed `/hero-clone-poc/`). **(4) Header-only inserter** — new `mobile-nav-inserter-scope.php` (`allowed_block_types_all` filter, fail-open) removes `sgs/mobile-nav` + `sgs/mobile-nav-toggle` from the post/page inserter while keeping them in the Site Editor (templates/parts/navigation); when `$allowed===true` it fetches the full registry and diffs out only the 2 chrome blocks (never a short list); wired via require_once in `class-sgs-blocks.php`. view.js confirmed close (native `popovertargetaction=hide`) + ESC + accordions bind regardless of trigger → an orphaned drawer stays closeable. block.json `version 3.0.1 → 3.0.3` (cache-bust — the deploy reused the `?ver=` param; surfaced live when the CSS fix didn't appear until the version bumped). Visual report `reports/visual-diff/mobile-nav-2026-06-01.md`. **NB headless top-layer quirk:** CDP `dispatchMouseEvent` synthetic clicks on popover-internal elements don't reliably trigger anchor nav / hit-test in headless Chrome; programmatic `.click()` + real taps work (proven by the successful navigation). **Deferred (low risk):** editor-inserter E2E (open post editor, confirm the 2 blocks absent) — fail-open design can't break the editor. This implements/closes the mobile-nav portion of D142's flagged flaw.

## 2026-06-02 (theme thread) — Task 1: shared visual IconPicker (D137)

**D137 — Shared visual IconPicker built + live-verified on sgs/icon + sgs/icon-list (SGS THEME thread Task 1).** Replaced the type-the-name icon UX (1,917 Lucide names typed from memory; icon-list's 8-slug `@wordpress/icons` dropdown) with a reusable `plugins/sgs-blocks/src/components/IconPicker/` modal: search box + keyboard-navigable radiogroup grid (roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End, role=radio + aria-checked, 44px targets, WCAG 2.2 AA) across 4 tabs — Lucide (1,917) / Emoji (1,914) / WordPress (49) / Dashicons (curated). **Architecture (research-grounded — research-check 2026-06-02; memory `2026-06-03-gutenberg-icon-picker-architecture` + blub.db):** do NOT inline SVGs into the editor bundle (WP core hit exactly that bundle-bloat wall in core/icon, gutenberg#75715). Instead `scripts/generate-icons.js` (prebuild) emits static JSON datasets to `assets/icons/` — `lucide-icons.json` (952KB, the SVG map) + `lucide-tags.json` (search aliases) + `emoji.json` (from new build-time devDep `unicode-emoji-json`) + `wp-icons.json` (parsed from the canonical `includes/wp-icons.php` so the editor preview is byte-identical to the frontend). Datasets are fetched on demand per editor session (module-cached promise), never bundled, never on the frontend. The block stores only `{iconSource, iconName}`; render.php resolves the SVG server-side (single source of truth preserved — R-22-1 spirit: generated from the same source, not a hand-dup). PHP localizes the asset URLs to `window.sgsBlocksData.iconAssets` via a `wp-blocks` `'before'` inline script (filemtime cache-bust). **icon-list:** per-item picker + a default-icon picker; render.php made source-aware (4 sources) with backwards-compat for legacy `{icon:slug}` items (legacy→Lucide map) + conditional Dashicons enqueue; dynamic `save:null` so attribute-shape change needs no deprecation. **Live-verified (R-22-11, Playwright on canary 144 logged-in editor):** picker trigger renders in inspector → modal 4 tabs → Lucide grid loads on FIRST open (300 cells, real SVGs) + Emoji (300) → search filters by name+tags → click sets the block attrs + closes modal; zero own console errors (the 39 page errors are pre-existing cloned-content: see below). **Bug caught + fixed during live verify:** first-open Lucide load stuck on "Loading…" while Emoji + 2nd-visit Lucide worked → root cause a React useEffect cleanup race stranding a separate `loading` flag on the first source loaded → fixed by DERIVING loading from data-presence (no separate flag). **Pre-existing bugs surfaced (Task 8 scope, NOT this work):** `sgs/media` edit.js throws `ReferenceError: imageId is not defined` (editor crash = the "media cannot be previewed" symptom); `sgs/container` block-validation failures on the cloned page (cloning-thread converter issue). **Remaining Task 1 family:** notice-banner picker wiring is Task 4 (+ per-type defaults + corner-radius).

## 2026-06-02 (session 3, cont.) — CSS-transfer fidelity audit + static-div editor-error fix (D136)

**D136 — The cloning pipeline does NOT faithfully transfer the draft's CSS — 4 systemic gaps found by a draft-vs-clone computed-style audit; principle locked + static-div editor bug fixed.** Bean reframed the section-width problem as the pipeline's CORE job: "this is literally just about transferring the CSS values that exist in the draft into the clone." A Playwright draft-vs-deployed-clone computed-style diff (@1440px, mockup served on localhost since `file://` is Playwright-blocked) proved 4 transfer failures: (1) **framework IMPOSES `max-width:1200`** on full-bleed sections (featured-product/ingredients/gift/social-proof) — the draft has no section max-width (Bean's deliberate blank rule); the WP page template constrains any non-`alignfull` child to wideSize. Recommended fix = **theme-CSS keyed on structural position**: `.entry-content > .wp-block-sgs-container { max-width:none }` (top-level sections full-bleed by POSITION; composite-nested + explicit-max-width containers unaffected) — answers Bean's "why can't the template tell a section from an inner wrapper" (it can, via `>`). (2) **pipeline DROPS the `__inner` content wrappers** (ingredients/gift/social-proof `__inner`, max-width:960) — the FR-22-4.1 fold collapses them → content constraint lost. (3) **framework PAINTS a hero gradient** (`linear-gradient(135°,#C56A7A→#E68A95)`) the draft (solid pink) never had — the `#C76C7C` from the global measurement-vs-eye rule. (4) **`grid-template-columns` not transferred** (trust-bar__inner draft 266×4 → clone uneven 143/132/111/160; brand draft 122/782 → clone 450/450). **Two converter band-aids REJECTED** by Bean (detect-max-width→set-widthMode, gated on is_class_section_block then on a regex) — the fix belongs in the transfer layer / theme-CSS, never a walker conditional (memory `feedback_pipeline_transfers_draft_css_not_converter_detection_hacks`, STOP #33). **Also fixed (committed) the static-div editor bug:** `emit_sgs_container_wrapping` wrapped children in a static `<div class="wp-block-sgs-container">` + inline `<style>`, but sgs/container `save()` is `<InnerBlocks.Content/>` → WP validation rejected it → "unexpected/invalid content" on every cloned container in the editor (+ an extra nesting level breaking grid-on-section, likely feeding gap 4). Fix mirrors the already-correct `_emit_section_container`: emit children directly, no div, no duplicate inline style (CSS is in variation_buf). The committed `widthMode:'full'` width fix (e27ff591) is a PARTIAL band-aid covering only slug-resolved sections — to be superseded by the faithful-transfer fix. **NEXT (cloning thread):** the 4 transfer gaps, the priority. Audit + reframing captured in `.claude/next-session-prompt.md` + `.claude/scratch/2026-06-02-brain-dump-variant-routing-and-issues.md`.

Universal across bare-tag AND BEM-class elements.

Scripted rename (`scripts/rename-hover-attrs.py`, word-boundary + longest-first), build green (dead-control 0 net-new), DB reseeded stage-1 (70 new attr rows), icon's dead legacy `hoverColour` fallback removed, 2 auxiliary tooling refs updated. Central `sgsHover*` extension untouched.
- **Fix 5b — converter mechanism (`018a8276`, D309).** `collect_state_decls_for_element` (styling_helpers) reuses the PROVEN base matcher on a per-state pseudo-stripped copy of the rules — fully isolated from the resting-base collection, so a `:hover` decl can NEVER leak into base (the qc-council fall-through trap is impossible by construction). `Decl.state` field (context.py) + `typography.resolve` appends the state suffix after the tier suffix; `validate()` gates on the block declaring `{attr}Hover`. BOTH CSS families carry it: `css_pass` (node's own CSS — the announcement headline) AND `styling_content` (derived-selector-matched element). `text-decoration` + `text-transform` brought into the typed-lift scope (`_TYPO_LIFT_TYPOGRAPHY_CSS_PROPS`) — they must transfer faithfully; both string enums (no Unit companion). **NO `property_suffixes` migration** (Bean's simplification). qc-council (3 cross-model raters) validated the shape + caught: the fall-through trap, the `:focus-visible` WCAG risk (avoided by deferring Part G), the `Decl`-is-in-context.py path, and that button lacks `scalar-styling-lift` (so the headline is served by `css_pass`, not `styling_content`).

Hover is not responsive → same rule at all widths, no 3-breakpoint variance. Converter suite **448 pass** (445 + 3 new `test_hover_state_lift.py`), 1 skip; F5/F6 + cheat-gate (0 NEW) clean.
- **DEFERRED (documented, NOT needed for the fix — button hover already correct):** Part E/G (wire button to the shared `sgs_typography_css_rule` helper + a helper hover pass) — pure DRY, and the council flagged a `:focus-visible` regression risk that deferral AVOIDS (the button keeps its correct combined `:hover,:focus-visible` rule). Part F (editor controls for text-decoration/text-transform/letter-spacing + a hover section in `TypographyControls`) — a client-facing "every-capability-is-a-control" enhancement, not required for the clone to render hover.

## 2026-07-10 — D301: colour styling-lift routes by DB ROLE (not a property-name list) + concrete-value fallback; 6 universal pill-cloning bugs fixed

**D301 — the styling-lift resolves a colour value by the DB-owned attr `role='color'`, never a hardcoded `css_property` allowlist, and keeps the concrete hex/rgba when no palette token matches.** Branch main; commits `5bb622d4` (3 bugs + BgColour migration), `1d15d491` (border shorthand), `2b43a6df` (border-color + rgba preservation), `89dcaf41` (role-based routing refactor). 440 converter tests pass throughout; verified on the live page-8 clone. D-ceiling was D300.

- **Bean-reported:** cloned pack pills rendered uniform taupe (D299 made them cloneABLE but the converter never populated the pill colours — the R11–R13 items the D299 report flagged UNVERIFIED, now proven broken on a real clone). Root-caused to 6 UNIVERSAL styling-lift bugs (benefit every clone, not per-block):
  1. **`BgColour` suffix gap** (`migrations/2026-07-10-property-suffixes-bg-colour.py`): `property_suffixes` had `BackgroundColour`+`Bg`+`Colour` but not `BgColour` — the framework's 7-block `*BgColour` naming peeled only `Colour`→`color`, so every bg-colour attr grabbed the element's TEXT colour. Added `BgColour`→`background-color`.
  2. **Compound-selector matching** (`styling_helpers.py::collect_css_decls_for_element`): a compound class selector `.a.b` had `last_part[1:]="a.b"` (dot inside), never a single class → dropped. The draft's selected rule `.__pill.__pill--active` was unmatched, so every SELECTED colour resolved to the RESTING value. Now parses the final compound's class tokens + matches iff the element carries all (higher class-count → higher specificity → compound wins).
  3–4. **`background` + `border` shorthand → longhand** (`styling_content.py`): drafts declare flat colour via the shorthand (`.pill{background:var(--cream)}` / `border:2px solid var(--border)`); the lift resolved `background-color`/`border-color` and missed the shorthand key. Now falls back to the colour-only shorthand (background: excludes gradient/url; border: extracts the colour token).
  5. **`border-color` never resolved** — `_compute_value` ran the colour resolver only for `color`/`background-color`; border-color fell to raw-string, so `var(--border)` stored the DRAFT's own var (dangling on SGS).
  6. **rgb()/rgba()/hsl() dropped** — `extract_token_or_hex` returned None for functional colours (only var()/#hex); a pale `rgba(230,138,149,0.1)` was dropped, or token-snapped to an opaque slug (alpha lost).
- **Bean anti-cheat correction (the load-bearing refactor).** Fix 5 initially added `border-color` to a hardcoded `(color,background-color,border-color)` list — Bean: that's a cheat (the NEXT colour property silently breaks; routing depends on the property NAME, not on whether the value resolves — a value can snap on one client's global palette and be missing on another). **Corrected:** `_compute_value` branches on the DB-owned `role=='color'` (threaded from `lift_styling_content` through `_emit_value`), so ANY colour property routes through `extract_token_or_hex`, whose match-vs-no-match branch keeps the concrete hex/rgba on no token match. R-31-1 + Spec 31 §3 step 6 (per-client divergences emit as raw instance values). **Do NOT reintroduce a css_property allowlist for colour routing.**
- **Result (live page 8):** pill 7/8 draft-accurate — resting cream bg / beige border (`border-subtle`) / muted text; selected pink border + dark text. **REMAINING (not converter):** selected FILL renders solid pink not the 10% tint — the attr extracts + stores the rgba correctly, but the picker defaults to `colourPreset='solid'` whose CSS sets `--sgs-op-sel-bg`=primary; the clone should set `colourPreset=''` when it supplies explicit per-pill colours (`P-PILL-SELECTED-FILL-PRESET`).

Also the default fold lifted ONLY `max-width`, so ingredients' band `text-align:center` dropped. **Fix (ONE fold mechanism, R-31-9):** a shared `_sole_passthrough_child` detector (§2.4, single-sources the "which inner folds" rule) + `build_block_markup` **step-3c** — for a composite (`rec.slug != container_default_slug()`, a DB signal not a literal) with a sole pass-through inner, fold its full band CSS via `route_interior_css_to_parent_slot` (the FR-31-5.3 router); the default-container fold switched to the SAME router (BEM-less-wrapper fallback to `lift_content_band_max_width`, legacy-path parity — qc-council Rater B). `route_interior_css_to_parent_slot` gained (a) co-declared `var()` resolution (max-width:var(--content-width)+--content-width:1100px → `1100px`, not the raw var) and (b) inheritable base-tier `text-align` → the block's WP-native `textAlign` support (renders `has-text-align-*`, cascades, child-overrideable), gated on `block_supports_for(slug).typography.textAlign` (no support → tracked gap, never a dead attr). **Empirical AFTER (real nodes):** trust-bar contentWidth=1100+gap, ingredients 960+textAlign=center, featured 1040, gift/social 960 UNREGRESSED. Grid-template EXCLUDED (GAP-3 — arrangement's concern). **Pre-commit qc-council (3 read-only raters, cross-checked file:line+DB+real draft): unanimous GO** — Rater A (code-path) all 6 points CONFIRMED no bug; Rater B (anti-cheat) no R-31-1/9/15 violation + the BEM-less fallback fix; Rater C (render) all 3 attrs paint + cascade. 374 tests (+4 `test_band_fold.py` regression locks) + cheat-gate 0 NEW; convert.py byte-identical (D-MODULAR). **LANDED on page 8 (`SGS_NEW_ENGINE=1` clone → sandybrown page 8 → anonymous computed-style):** trust-bar band `max-width`=1100px, featured=1040px, ingredients/gift/social=960px (all match the draft). **Render-side follow-on (STOP-21 caught it — the textAlign fold was WRITTEN-not-LANDED):** the emitted `textAlign` attr did NOT render — WP core does not merge `has-text-align-*` into `get_block_wrapper_attributes()` for this dynamic composite wrapper (verified live, WP 7.0). Fix = `SGS_Container_Wrapper::render` emits `has-text-align-{textAlign}` explicitly when the block sets it (universal, every container-equivalent declaring `supports.typography.textAlign`); WPCS 0 errors. **D259 — the live CSS-transfer path silently DROPPED `min-width:600` (trust-bar 4-col → rendered 2-col; same root cause as products/gift/ingredients, D256). Fixed universally in the shared collector. NOT pushed. 320 tests (+9) + cheat-gate (0 NEW, 73 baselined) green; convert.py byte-identical (D-MODULAR). LANDED verify page 8 pending.**

- **Root cause (proven vs the real draft `mamas-trust-bar-real.html`):** `collect_css_decls_for_element` (`converter/services/styling_helpers.py`) matched each `@media` rule by SUBSTRING against a fixed marker table (`_BREAKPOINT_RULES`, db_lookup.py) and, on no match, fell through WITHOUT writing/logging — `min-width:600` (∉ the 5 markers) was silently discarded. The draft's `__inner` is `1fr 1fr` base + `@media(min-width:600px){repeat(4,1fr)}`; the 4-col override vanished → base kept the 2-col mobile value → rendered 2-col everywhere.
- **The real shape = a mobile-first→desktop-base INVERSION, not just "un-drop" (Bean-chosen scope: universal shared collector, not a grid-only carve-out).** SGS blocks are desktop-base (the unsuffixed attr IS Desktop; `tier_suffix._BASE_TIER`), but mockups are mobile-first (base CSS = mobile). Half-fixing (Desktop→base only) would break mobile (render 4-col on phones).
- **Fix = device-tier CASCADE (Spec 31 §13.4 FR-31-5.2, newly DEFINED — it was referenced at §3 line 260 but never specified):** `collect_css_decls_for_element` computes the effective value per tier by sampling the CSS cascade at interior widths (Desktop 1440 / Tablet 800 / Mobile 375; `db_lookup.device_tier_samples`), then maps Desktop→base, Tablet/Mobile→suffixed (override only where ≠ base). `min-width:X` populates every tier whose sample ≥ X; `max-width:X` every tier ≤ X — ONE symmetric calculation, both directions. Kept the 2-tuple return (no ripple across the ~10 callers); only the SEMANTICS of base_decls (now desktop-effective) changed. `grid.py` needs no edit — Desktop folds into base, so the resolver's existing tier→attr mapping lands it.
- **F-ii residual (D228 lock):** a non-device threshold (∉ {767,768,1023,1024}, e.g. 600/640) has a sub-tier band the 3-tier model can't hold — surfaced via a non-silent `sgs.converter.styling` log (never snapped, never silently dropped). Raw-band passthrough-CSS rendering is a tracked follow-up; the covered tiers land in full.
- **Verify:** 9 new regression tests (`test_minwidth_cross_device_tier.py`) prove the inversion on the real trust-bar draft + the symmetric max-width direction + F-ii residual logging + `_media_condition_applies_at` boundaries; 320 total green; cheat-gate clean (new 768/1024 constants live in db_lookup, outside `check_parallel_bp`'s convert.py-only integer scan). **LANDED on page 8 is the closing gate (STOP-21/37; Bean eye, R-31-13) — trust-bar + products + gift + ingredients at 1440 vs draft — pending.**

(4) **Tier A corrected:** child-block vs scalar vs array = `canonical_slot` + `role` + `attr_type` together (spec FR-22-2.1 omits the role/type gating the running code already applies). **Implementation (DB-only):** added a bare `content` element-slot (`scope='element'`, `aliases=[]`, `standalone_block=NULL` — empty aliases by design, never matched against draft classes) via `seed-slot-synonyms.py`; tagged the 41 `contentWidth`/`contentPadding*`/`contentMaxWidth*` rows `content`/`layout`. **`/sgs-update` is the deterministic mechanism — no manual seed script.** Investigation confirmed `assign-canonical.py` (run automatically by `/sgs-update` Stage 1) tags these rows `content`/`layout` deterministically once the `content` slot row + the `Width`/`Padding`→`layout` `property_suffixes` rows exist (all present). The throwaway `seed-canonical-slots.py` was therefore **deleted as redundant parallel infra** (the DB values it wrote persist; `/sgs-update` maintains + extends them). **Side effect (accepted):** `assign-canonical` also labelled 20 other same-stem rows `content` — 6 layout/enum (correct) + 13 `text-content` (core/* off-roster + `sgs/heading content`); inert because `content` has no `standalone_block` (same dual-use pattern as `media`: one slot, `role` disambiguates layout-box from text). **Guard:** `content` must never gain a `standalone_block` without re-auditing those 13 rows. **No 3-layer canonical split (Bean, confirmed):** the 3 layers (OUTER/CONTENT/GRID) already map onto existing vocabulary — OUTER=NULL (root box), CONTENT=`content`, GRID=existing `gap`/`column`/`gridItem*` — so splitting `content` into container/content/grid canonicals would re-couple `canonical_slot` to routing (contra this decision) + overlap; the layers stay a converter-side routing concept, not DB values. **No draft `content-width` rename (Bean clarified):** the draft's direct-descendant inner-wrapper `max-width`+`margin:auto` (e.g. `.sgs-x__inner{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto}`) IS the source the converter maps to the block's `contentWidth` attr (FR-22-21 step 3); `max-width` stays (correct + universal for scraped drafts), the mapping is documented, not renamed. `sgs/container` needs no hand-seeding — `/sgs-update` tidies any remaining attr gaps. Design-gate doc: `.claude/specs/archive/WRAPPER-CSS-ROUTING-DESIGN-GATE.md`. `assign-canonical.py` unchanged (preserves explicit values via `WHERE canonical_slot IS NULL` + COALESCE, live-verified). NO pixel-diff gate needed — metadata-only, zero converter-output change. (CLONING thread; theme co-active on main — path-scoped commits.)
