## 2026-06-02 (theme thread) — Task 6 cta-section rich variations + Task 7a product-card gift delete (D140)

**D135 — Rollout finding: slot-fingerprint detection (FR-22-20) fits ONLY content-distinct, modifier-less variants; the stylistic/behavioural MAJORITY need a complementary modifier-class→enum path (a spec amendment, NOT a slot-`variants` sweep).** Investigating Commit 6 ("generalise to the other ~24 variant blocks", per D133) surfaced that the slot-fingerprint mechanism does NOT generalise as D133 assumed. Evidence (block.json audit): **gallery** (layout: grid/masonry/carousel) shares `mediaItems`/`images` across all layouts; **heading** (variantStyle: default/hero/section/card) shares `content`; **divider** (line/dots/wave/shape) + **mobile-nav** (overlay/slide-left/slide-right/bottom-sheet) have NO content/object/array attrs at all. Their variants are purely stylistic/behavioural (same content, different CSS/animation) → **zero discriminating slots** → `detect_variant` always returns None → declaring `supports.sgs.variants` on them would silently never fire. The **hero is the exception**: its variants populate genuinely-different media attrs (backgroundImage vs splitImage vs backgroundVideo vs svgContent) AND the draft carries no `--variant` modifier class (`<section class="sgs-hero">`), so slot-fingerprint was the only available signal. Stylistic-variant drafts instead carry a BEM modifier class (`sgs-gallery--masonry`, `sgs-divider--wave`, `sgs-heading--hero`). The EXISTING modifier-class lift in `lift_behavioural_attrs` (db_lookup.py:2066-2109) does NOT cover this: it only fires for modifiers in `modifier_suffixes` kind='variant' (just Primary/Secondary/Tertiary) AND matches attr-NAME==modifier — it would never set `layout='masonry'` from `--masonry`. So the stylistic majority is handled by NEITHER mechanism. **Correct rollout = a complementary `detect_variant_from_modifier` path** (when the resolved block has a `variant_attr` and the draft node carries a BEM modifier matching a value in that attr's enum, set it) — a SECOND, universal detection mechanism that needs its own brainstorming/spec + a canary test target (Mama's has no gallery/divider with a modifier, so no live-DOM gate exists for it yet) before build (R-22-11). product-card's slot-`variants` mapping is additionally gated on its PARKED variation-sets design (D129, P-PRODUCT-CARD-FULL-DUAL-MODE). **Action:** the universal mechanism (hero) is SHIPPED + live-verified; the broad rollout is re-scoped as a focused next step needing the modifier-class mechanism (parking P-FR2220-VARIANT-DETECTION updated). Do NOT declare non-functional slot-`variants` on stylistic blocks (would give false coverage). Evidence-first per R-22-6/R-22-9/R-22-10; do-not-ram-new-mechanism per STOP #32.

**D134 — FR-22-20 universal variant detection BUILT (Commits 1-4 of 6) + emit-proven + LIVE-DOM VERIFIED; hero `$is_split` band-aid REVERTED.** Implemented Spec 22 §FR-22-20 / D133 on branch `feat/fr22-4-1-universal-wrapper` across 4 R-22-5 commits: (1) `1a48c602` DB schema — `blocks.variant_attr` column + `variant_slots` table (idempotent module-load migration in db_lookup.py mirroring `_migrate_property_suffixes_kind_override`); (2) `278b99ac` hero block.json declares `supports.sgs.variantAttr:"variant"` + `variants` map (standard→backgroundImage, split→splitImage/splitImageMobile/splitColumnRatio/splitGap, video→backgroundVideo/bgVideo, svg-animated→svgContent); (3) `5db969cf` /sgs-update Stage 1 populates `variant_attr` (write-on-drift) + `variant_slots` (DISCRIMINATING set-difference: a variant's slots minus the union of sibling variants' slots; live-verified 8 hero rows, all discriminating); (4) `55f42e1b` converter detector — db_lookup `variant_attr_for()` + `_variant_slots_map()` + `detect_variant()` + a convert.py emit-path enrichment after the `sourceMode` block (R-22-3: NOT a 4th walk branch; gated by `variant_attr_for`) + REVERT hero render.php `$is_split` back to `('split' === $variant)`. **detect_variant reads the draft's EXTRACTED attrs THIS run (`attrs` dict at emit), never stored attrs → closes the stale-data hole.** R-22-1 (DB-driven, no slug literals/dicts), R-22-9 (one mechanism for all 33 variant blocks). **3-rater cross-model qc-council (Sonnet rules + Haiku logic + Sonnet pipeline-trace, R-22-12)** triangulated ONE real bug: detect_variant used truthiness → dropped a legitimately-extracted numeric `0`/`False` (would flip detection on a 0-valued discriminator, violating R-22-9). FIXED via `_slot_extracted` (presence-of-meaningful-value: counts 0/False, excludes only None/''/empty-container — covers Rater A placeholder + Rater C empty-dict edges). Pipeline-trace rater READ convert.py + confirmed the hero reaches the enrichment with `splitImage` already lifted into `attrs` by `_route_composite_interior`; `attrs` flows unchanged into `emit_sgs_container_wrapping`. **EMIT-PROVEN** (production converter CLI on the Mama's hero section): hero now emits `sgs/hero{...,"variant":"split"}` (was: splitImage+splitImageMobile but NO variant attr) — single sgs/hero, no double-wrapper, images lifted scalar, art-direction CSS in variation buffer. Unit test 10/10 (orig 7 + numeric-0 + empty-dict + 0-tie). **LIVE-DOM VERIFIED (R-22-11, Commit 5 DONE)** — deployed hero block (build-deploy blocks-only) + fresh full-page /sgs-clone re-clone to canary 144 (run `mamas-munches-144-2026-06-01-053427`, `--converter-v2 --debug-trace`) + Playwright on the deployed page: hero carries **`sgs-hero--split`** class (render.php emits `sgs-hero--{$variant}`; with the band-aid REVERTED the only path to 'split' is the detector) + **1** `.sgs-hero__content` (double-wrapper gone) + **1** `.sgs-hero__media` + **2** `.sgs-hero__split-image` (mobile+desktop) + content textLen 217 + 2-col grid. The split layout now renders through the CLEAN variant gate, not the cheat. Pixel-diff 62.4% (informational per FR-22-18; images dry-run 404). Full chain proven: DB→block.json→/sgs-update→detector→emit→deployed render→live DOM. **REMAINING (Commit 6):** generalise `supports.sgs.variants` to other variant blocks — NB only blocks whose variants are SLOT-DISTINCT (different attrs populated, e.g. product-card/gallery/mobile-nav) benefit from fingerprint detection; purely-stylistic variants (heading/label/text/divider — same content, different CSS) need the BEM-modifier-class signal instead, NOT variant_slots. Emit-proof artefact: `c:/tmp/fr2220/emit-proof.txt`.

## 2026-07-18 (LATEST) — [ROUTINE] D346: Framework-wide inline-zero rollout COMPLETE (Facet A+B shared-wrapper design-gate + all block conversions)

Executed the D345 rollout end-to-end. **Both live sites now render EVERY `sgs/*` block with ZERO inline `style` attributes** (verified live: palestine-lives Indus + sandybrown Mama's — page-wide `style="--"`=0, empty `style=""`=0; started at ~53 inline on the Indus homepage). Method: a live-render-driven detector (`plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/no-inline/detect.py`) collapsed the plan's unproven "~52 blocks" to the real ~9, then two mechanisms cleared them.

**Two-facet shared-`SGS_Container_Wrapper` change (Bean-approved Rule-7 design-gate) — the high-leverage move:**
- **Facet A:** the wrapper's `get_block_wrapper_attributes()` (both call sites — the pre-uid pass + the operative `$uid`/shape rebuild) now emits the `'style'` key ONLY when `$styles` is non-empty. Fixed the empty `style=""` on every content-KIND composite + all header/footer roots, centrally, with NO per-block edits (dissolved the header/footer co-session collision).

## 2026-07-14 — [ROUTINE] D337: FR-S9-5 amended to test OUTCOME not MECHANISM (Bean-delegated); Task 1a answered; adaptive-nav `<dialog>` drawer built (Wave 1, branch)

**D337 — Two FR-S9-5 acceptance criteria mandated the D323 *workaround* rather than the *goal*, so the better `<dialog>` design would have read as FAILING its own governing spec and a future session would have "fixed" it back. Bean delegated the call ("go with your expert recommendation"). Both amended to be intent-based; original wording preserved struck-through for audit.**

- **Amendment 1 — "drawer is a direct child of `<body>` at open time"** → **"drawer is genuinely interactive while open AND the background is genuinely frozen"**, verified by the elementFromPoint sweep (baseline **18/18 Indus, 10/10 Mama's**, measured 2026-07-14) + background unreachable. **Mechanism is free.** The old wording enshrined the re-parent hack the D323 fix used; a modal `<dialog>` (`showModal()`) satisfies the intent *by construction* — it is the only element that escapes inertness (MDN), so it cannot self-inert regardless of DOM position, which is the exact bug D323 was. Requiring the hack would forbid the stronger design.
- **Amendment 2 — `aria-current` on the toggle** → **dropped from the toggle; REQUIRED on the drawer's links.** `aria-current` means "current item in a set"; on an open/close button it is a category error. `aria-expanded` + a CSS class is the correct + sufficient ARIA APG disclosure signal. Cargo-cult ARIA removed, meaningful use kept.
- **Amendment 3 (added) — no static `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal` on a closed drawer.** Modality must be conferred at open time. The pre-D337 `sgs/mobile-nav` shipped a permanently-present `aria-modal="true"` (verified on the live Indus DOM today) which hides the ENTIRE page from assistive tech while the menu is shut — WP core fixed this exact bug in 2021 (gutenberg#37434).
- **Task 1a ANSWERED (Bean's question: "benefit or just remaking it?") — a real benefit, but the handoff's reason was WRONG and the right shape is a small REBUILD, not a port.** (a) **There is no "delegation seam"** — adaptive-nav has ZERO coupling to the drawer (no include/call/id/event); `render.php:8` is a *comment*. It is a **3-block assembly**, and it is **already broken in 3 shipped patterns** (`header-search-{icon,bar-below,bar-above}` place the toggle WITHOUT adaptive-nav, whose global CSS is the only thing revealing the burger → drawer unreachable at every viewport — the Kadence/Blocksy "empty drawer" class, live in our own repo). (b) **mobile-nav is not worth porting** — ~4,200 lines; `drawerBg`/`linkColour`/`breakpoint` controls are dead; a client literal (`#075e80`) in framework CSS; **backdrop-dismiss never implemented** (FR-S9-5 criterion failing today); uncached `do_blocks()`+`DOMXPath` per request; N+1 `get_pages()`. (c) **`<dialog>` kills the D323 bug class by construction** and WP core is migrating to it (Make/Core 2026-03-04; PR #69720 *"Removes implementation of focus trapping"*). "Nothing lost" is judged on **RENDERED OUTPUT, not attribute count** — you cannot lose a control that never did anything.
- **Row-fold research (Bean rejected "combo mode" as hardcoding — correctly).** Evidence: the live header uses **5 block instances + 8 hand-set tier flags for 3 contact items** (phone + email each authored twice; socials via two different mechanisms). Answer: **split the problem** — nav *links* need runtime measurement (already built: adaptive-nav's More menu); header *blocks* are 3–7 curated items whose fold order is knowable at render → **declare server-side** (author once, framework emits twice — row + drawer — CSS picks per tier; already the house pattern via `SGS_Nav_Menu_Source`, and architecturally free: uid is a CLASS from `md5(attrs)`, the D311 collector dedupes by content hash). Best declarative API found = **Fluent UI v9 `Overflow`** (`priority` + `pinned`, where pinned IS priority=∞ — one mechanism, not two); Gutenberg has no equivalent (#24805/#41347 open) → SGS would be first in the WP ecosystem. **Must be a single enum** (a responsive family fails `check-control-ux.js` — the D331 wall). **Bean's variants premise corrected:** `sgs/mega-menu` has ZERO variations; **`sgs/business-info` has 8** (scope `['inserter','transform']`, `isActive:['displayType']`) → the settings-panel switcher he wanted is real, shipped, and his own (D331) — memory attached to the wrong block. Variants ✅ for fold policy (attributes), ❌ for structure (`onSelectVariation` = `updateBlockAttributes` only). **Lateral: fold-defaults are a PRECONDITION for Spec 33 Part 2** (the cloner emits headers with no human → defaults must be right by construction), not a feature beside it.
- **Wave 1 BUILT + on branch `feat/adaptive-nav-dialog-drawer` (`8a1927f5`, pushed) — deliberately NOT wired up** (theme still uses mobile-nav → it is inert live; parked off `main` because a half-migration on `main` would deploy TWO burgers). `allowedBlocks` removed (STOP-NO-ALLOWLIST); inner blocks routed by name (mega-menu→bar, else→drawer drop-zone — also unblocks `P-DRAWER-MOVABLE-OVERFLOW-DROPZONE`); socials from `Sgs_Site_Info` ONLY **with the `use` statement whose absence caused D336**; no hand-rolled focus trap / no `inert` / no re-parent. All gates green. **qc-council (2 raters) GO-WITH-FIXES; their DB-first template-part warning was FACT-CHECKED and does NOT apply** (no `wp_template_part` named `header` on either client; Indus's 3 stubs contain zero `sgs/*` blocks) → the file swap will take effect, no Site-Editor migration needed. **A real design save:** collapsing the whole root would put `display:none` on an ANCESTOR of the dialog, suppressing top-layer rendering even for `showModal()` — breaking the drawer at exactly the tier it is needed; collapse is scoped to `__nav`/`__toggle`.
- **WAVE 2 (EXECUTED — corrected 2026-07-16; this line previously read "not started" and was flagged as actively misleading by a qc-council spec-rater):** theme swap + the 3 search patterns (**a mini header-restructure, not a toggle swap — and it closes a second WooCommerce Block-Hooks leak**, D324) + delete mobile-nav/-toggle **atomically with** `site-header/edit.js:66` TEMPLATE (else every FRESH header insert instantiates a deleted block — a day-1 break for the next client build), `site-header-row/block.json:52`, `class-sgs-blocks.php:51` require + fixtures → `/sgs-update` (93 attrs pruned) → canary-first deploy → live-verify both clients incl. **VoiceOver+Safari** (axe-core cannot catch modality bugs). **Shipped by commit `7c60b8ff` ("wire the theme to adaptive-nav drawer + delete mobile-nav (Wave 2)") on `feat/adaptive-nav-dialog-drawer`. NB: `mobile-nav` STILL EXISTS on `main` — this deletion lands only when the branch merges.**

## 2026-07-14 — [INCIDENT] D336: BOTH client sites taken down (~2.5h) by an uncommitted edit deployed from the working tree; deploy safety net was 3-for-3 inert; hardened + the documented bypass closed

**D336 — An unfinished, uncommitted edit reached BOTH live client sites and 500'd them for ~2.5 hours while the deploy reported success. Cause PROVEN (not inferred): restoring the single file returned both sites to HTTP 200. Root cause of the SAFETY failure: all three existing defences were inert. Fixed + the bypass paths closed.**

- **The break.** `class-mobile-nav-renderer.php` carried an uncommitted working-tree edit (a prior session's start on the D335 one-source socials directive) calling `Sgs_Site_Info::get()` from a **global-namespace file with no `use SGS\Blocks\Sgs_Site_Info;`** → `Error: Class not found`. Every other caller has the `use` (`business-info/render.php:32`, `social-icons/render.php:39`, `migrations/0002:18`); no `class_alias` exists. `showSocials` defaults `true`, so it fired on every page with the drawer. A full 182-file deploy at **14:57** pushed it to sandybrown AND palestine-lives — **`build-deploy.py` tars the WORKING TREE, not HEAD**. Detected 17:24; both restored to 200 by re-uploading the HEAD file + OPcache reset + LiteSpeed purge.
- **Why nothing caught it — three inert defences (all verified in code, not assumed):** (1) the dirty gate called `git_is_dirty()` over the **whole repo**, which is permanently dirty (`.claude/` reports, `package-lock.json`, `phase4-*.txt`, `rr.json`), so **every documented command already carried `--allow-dirty`** (verified: 5+ live docs incl. `INTEGRATION.md:52`) → the gate protected nothing; (2) `step_verify` was **opt-in** (`--verify-url` default `None`) → never ran; (3) `step_verify`'s own docstring read *"Warns on failure; never aborts"* → even when run it exited 0. **Note `php -l` would NOT have caught this** — a missing `use` is a RUNTIME class-resolution failure, not a syntax error. Only fetching the real page catches it.
- **Hardened `build-deploy.py`:** `git_is_dirty()` → **`deployed_dirty_files()`**, scoped to tracked+dirty files that BOTH ship in the tarball AND execute in WP (`.php/.js/.css/.html/.json` under `theme/sgs-theme/`|`plugins/sgs-blocks/`, minus `src/`/`_retired/`/`styles/`/`scripts/`/`tests/`, minus lockfiles + the generated `lucide-icons.php`). Scoping is the point: a gate that fires on routine churn gets `--allow-dirty`'d into irrelevance — exactly how the old one died. Verified: **quiet on current dirt**, and **would have blocked the 14:57 deploy** (9/9 path cases). `step_verify` → **default-ON, fail-closed** (cache-busted GET; aborts on 5xx/4xx or a WP fatal in the body; `--skip-verify` to opt out); proven to exit 1 on a real 500 AND on a mocked fatal-with-200, exit 0 on both live sites. **Rollback net:** `step_remote_extract` no longer `rm -rf`s the live dir before extracting — it rotates it to `<dir>.bak` (one generation), so recovery is one `mv`. **That `rm -rf`-with-no-backup is why today was 2.5h and not 30s.**
- **The bypass closed — this was the load-bearing fix (a `/qc-council` caught it; 2 raters converged independently).** The code fix alone was **operationally inert**: `.claude/dev-setup.md:427` documented a raw `tar`/`scp` sequence titled *"Full deployment (recommended)"* aimed at **palestine-lives** with zero gates, plus a *"Single-file patch"* raw `scp`; line 478 routed *"palestine-lives + production → /wp-sgs-deploy"*, scoping the safe script to the canary only. So the REAL client site was documented for an ungated deploy. Raw sequences **removed**; `build-deploy.py` is now the deploy path for **every** target (production = `--target palestine-lives`, opt-in enforced in code); `--allow-dirty` stripped from the live canned commands (`INTEGRATION.md`, the no-inline rollout plan) with a note to READ the listed paths rather than re-add the flag; Spec 19 guards section rewritten. **Lesson: a gate every documented command bypasses is theatre — fix the docs in the same pass as the gate, or the gate does not exist.**
- **Deviation from Bean's approval, flagged:** Bean approved "commit lucide-icons.php" to quiet the gate; instead it is **allowlisted** — STOP-PARALLEL-TRACK-SWEEP explicitly names `lucide-icons.php` as pre-existing dirt that is *not this session's to commit*, and an allowlist is durable (a commit only holds until the file is regenerated, whose sole diff is a `Last generated:` timestamp).
- **Residual (parked, from the council):** verify checks the homepage only (a fatal on an inner page / block / logged-in-only path still passes); no canary-first enforcement for `--target palestine-lives`; `--target=x` equals-form misses the opt-in check (fails safe); a committed-but-broken file passes the dirty gate (verify is the net).

- **Editor** (`src/components/ResponsiveOverride.js` + `src/utils/responsive.js` mirror): SGS-owned device switcher (`role=tablist` + arrow-key roving tabindex, 44px, inherited value via icon + `aria-label` not colour-alone [WCAG 1.4.1], keyboard reset-to-inherited); NOT WP `__experimental`. `makeResponsive`/`makeBoxSides` write canonical key order → stable uid.

## 2026-07-13 — D320: FR-33-12 fail-closed freshness gate (Spec 33 Phase 5) — extractor is a hard prerequisite of any clone

**D320 — a `/sgs-clone` run now HALTS unless the deployed theme snapshot was generated by the Spec 33 extractor for the CURRENT draft.** Branch `main` (D-ceiling D319→D320). Phase 5 of Spec 33 Part 1 (FR-33-12 + the pipeline/spec docs).

- **The gap:** the converter exact-hex-snaps draft colours against `settings.color.palette` in `sites/<client>/theme-snapshot.json` (`styling_helpers._load_theme_palette_map`, which fails soft to `{}` on a missing/stale file), but nothing enforced that the extractor generated that snapshot for the current draft — a clone could convert against a stale snapshot and silently mis-paint (the exact D318/D319 class).
- **Fix (build):** (1) new `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/shared_utils.py` — the SINGLE source of `extract_css` + `css_sha256`/`draft_css_sha256`, imported by BOTH the extractor and the orchestrator so the two hashes can never drift. (2) `extract.py` embeds `_sgsExtractor.draft_css_sha256` INSIDE the snapshot itself (survives the additive merge, WP ignores the unknown top-level key, `push-theme-snapshot` posts only styles+settings so it never reaches the live DB; deterministic — no timestamp). (3) `sgs-clone-orchestrator.py` `_freshness_gate` reads that embedded key from the CANONICAL `theme-snapshot.json` (the exact file the converter loads) and fail-closes (`sys.exit`) if the file is absent, carries no `_sgsExtractor` (hand-authored/pre-gate), or its hash ≠ the current draft; `--skip-freshness-gate` opts out (extract-only/diagnostic only; the one caller reaching `main()`, `scripts/qc-correctness-regression.py`, passes it). (4) Mama's `theme-snapshot.json` regenerated additively to carry `_sgsExtractor` (only that block added).
- **Process (worked — a blocker was caught pre-merge):** pre-build `/qc-council` (2 cross-model raters) validated the fix-shape + placement + CI blast radius; a `feature-dev` code-review then caught a real BLOCKER in the first design — freshness was stamped on a SIBLING file tied to `theme-snapshot.generated.json`, so the gate could pass while the canonical `theme-snapshot.json` (what the converter reads) was stale/absent. Fixed by embedding the key IN the canonical file (reviewer's option a). Extends STOP-21 (emit-green ≠ landed) to "verify the gate proves the file-that-is-USED is fresh, not that the extractor ran at some point."
- **Docs (Phase 5 Task 2):** `cloning-pipeline-flow.md`/`-stages.md` add the extractor as the OPENING pipeline step; Spec 31 §3.A step 6 gains the bootstrap-dependency cross-reference (previously undocumented); root `CLAUDE.md` gains the Spec 33 pointer.
- **Verified:** 18 extractor tests + frozen hex-helper golden (FR-33-10) + orchestrator suites green; gate HALTs on absent/no-key/stale, proceeds on match, moot when no client; snapshot regeneration purely additive; determinism byte-identical. **FR-33-12 SHIPPED. NEXT: Phase 6 (FR-33-5 Pass B advisory + FR-33-6 dark-theme + FR-33-13 namespace + component-CSS migration).**

## 2026-07-11 — D305: heading text-wrap fidelity — cloned headings render the draft's greedy `wrap`, authored keep the theme's `balance` (Bean Option 1)

**D305 — the hero H1 wrapped "Made for" instead of the draft's "Made for the" at 800px; root-caused to `text-wrap: balance`.** Branch main. Investigation (all measured live, draft vs clone at 800px): H1 typography is byte-identical (52px, −1px, Fraunces; "Made for the" = 301.7px in BOTH) and the column is 304px in both — so NOT width/font. The theme applies `text-wrap: balance` to all headings (`core-blocks-critical.css` `h1..h6,.wp-block-heading`), a deliberate enhancement; the draft declares NO `text-wrap` → CSS-initial `wrap` (greedy). `balance` re-distributes words for even lines, pushing "the" down. PROVEN: forcing `text-wrap:wrap` on the live clone reproduced the draft's exact wrap. **Bean chose Option 1 (faithful for clones, keep balance for authored):** new `sgs/heading.textWrap` attr (block.json, default `''`); render.php emits `text-wrap:<value>` at `$root_sel` (`.uid.wp-block-sgs-heading` 0,2,0, beats theme `h1..h6` 0,0,1) when set; `converter/services/assembly.py` step 3a3 sets `textWrap` to the draft's EFFECTIVE text-wrap (declared, else CSS-initial `wrap`) on cloned headings — DB-gated on the block declaring `textWrap` (`db_lookup.block_attrs`, only sgs/heading, inert elsewhere), universal, no slug literal, mirrors the step-3a2 tag-identity / step-3b layout-trigger precedent (Spec 31 FR-31-5.1 absent→initial). Seeded via `/sgs-update --stage 1` (+1 attr row). Authored headings leave `textWrap` empty → inherit `balance`. **Verified live** (page 1356): `textWrap:wrap` → computed `text-wrap:wrap`; no `textWrap` → `balance`. Converter suite 440 pass (no golden regression). **Also this session:** multi-button `flex-wrap` default `wrap`→`nowrap` (buttons stacked at ~800px, `fc05fe70`); hero `.sgs-hero--split` hardcoded 16px grid gap removed (column 5px too narrow, `b8789ae7`) — both the same D228 pattern (a framework default overriding the draft's faithfully-absent value). **Page-8 live LANDING = next-session re-clone** (existing headings pre-date the fix). D-ceiling was D304.

## 2026-07-10 — D303: universal residual render-precedence + tier-confined bounding architecture (bound + fold + match-specificity + source-order + normalise; NO ID escalation)

**D303 — the universal, theme-wide fix for the two proven pipeline typography-fidelity gaps (D302 root-cause).** Branch main, commits `83d133aa` (M1 core, pushed) + `da58ea48` (M2 snapshot). **SHIPPED + LANDED + verified live 375/768/1440.** Spec 31 §3 F-fork + §13.4 FR-31-5.2 + FR-31-22.3 + Spec 32 §6.1(b) amended. D-ceiling was D302.

**OUTCOME (all verified live on sandybrown page 8):** M1 (residual precedence) SHIPPED — hero H1 = 58px @≥1280 (was 52), 34/52/58 across 375/768/1440, bounded residuals dormant outside their band, 7 blocks normalised + render correctly. **STOP-21 caught live:** multi-button rendered `display:block` on a GREEN build because `$uid` was applied as an id not a class — fixed by adding `$uid` to the class list; memory `normalise-scope-needs-uid-as-class-not-just-selector`. **Task 2 pills** already resolved by D301/D302 + reclone (verified). **M2 (section-heading letter-spacing)** fixed THEME-SIDE: the Mama's snapshot's arbitrary `h1 -0.022em`/`h2 -0.015em` (copied into all 6 client snapshots, not from any draft) removed → section h2s render `normal` (draft-faithful), hero h1 keeps −1px (block lift). **Bean-directed follow-up:** the GENERAL effective-value-lift MECHANISM (lift inherited/initial typography so a clone overrides ANY theme default) parked as `P-EFFECTIVE-VALUE-TYPOGRAPHY-LIFT` (fresh-session build — changes conformance goldens).

- **Root cause (both PROVEN live on page 8, matched-rule trace — not code-inference).** (M1) Hero H1 renders 52px not the draft's 58px @≥1280 because the `sgsCustomCss` residual (`.sgs-c-XXXX`, specificity 0,1,0) LOSES to the block's own scoped rule (`.uid.wp-block-sgs-heading`, 0,2,0) — a plain specificity deficit, NOT the `#uid`-vs-class contest D289/STOP-64 first framed (the heading emits at class-level, not ID). (M2) section H2s render theme Fraunces letter-spacing −0.54px because the draft's effective value (`normal`) was never lifted → the theme default wins.
- **Bean stress-tested the fix across three angles** (tablet-bleed, band-above, unset-tier) and drove two corrections: (a) a strength-only fix would EXPOSE a latent defect — the residual is emitted with the draft's RAW, unbounded `media_cond`, so a `min-width:600` residual (the Mama's ingredients grid uses one) would bleed up and override the tablet/desktop tiers; (b) the fix must be symmetric for min/max and must "extend until the next explicitly-set value takes over."
- **Research (2 Sonnet agents: WP/Gutenberg docs + Kadence/Spectra/GenerateBlocks source) REVERSED the initial ID idea.** WordPress core (6.6 `:root :where()` = 0-1-0, deliberately low) AND all three leading block plugins resolve per-instance style overrides by **equal-low-specificity + SOURCE ORDER, never ID/`!important` escalation**; none support arbitrary per-block breakpoints (only fixed-tier pixel values); bounded `min+max` is used only for an EXCLUSIVE mid-range band (Kadence `tabletOnly`). Confirms our own D289 lesson.
- **The approved 4-part universal architecture (M1):** (1) **BOUND** each residual to the device tier its threshold falls inside (`min-width:X`→`[X, tier-upper-edge]`; `max-width:X`→`[tier-lower-edge, X]`; symmetric — so it never bleeds); (2) **FOLD** — a value spanning a whole tier goes into that tier's attr (existing whole-tier folding carries a value up through an unset tier; the residual holds only the sub-tier remainder — delivers "extend to next set value" for free); (3) **MATCH SPECIFICITY + WRITE LAST** — residual at the SAME class-level specificity as the block rule (double the scope class, 0,2,0), appended last, wins by source order (NOT ID); (4) **NORMALISE** every block's per-instance styling to one class-level specificity (fix the ~2 `#uid` emitters — mobile-nav, collapsible-text). **M2:** lift the draft's EFFECTIVE (computed, inherited-chain) letter-spacing + line-height onto every text element (FR-31-5.1 extended), routed by DB role (D301), so nothing falls to a theme default that differs from the draft.
- **Roster-wide specificity audit (Bean-directed — corrects an earlier partial claim).** Of 74 render.php: **40 route through the shared `SGS_Container_Wrapper`** which scopes at a SINGLE class `.uid` (0,1,0) — this IS the consistent per-instance standard, and the residual was calibrated to it; **14 emit no per-instance styling**; **~2 self-roll at class** (heading/card-grid, `.uid.block` 0,2,0); **7 self-roll at ID** (`#uid`) — button, text, feature-grid, multi-button, mega-menu, mobile-nav, collapsible-text. Those 7 are the ONLY blocks the residual can't beat. The ID was **partly deliberate but overkill**: feature-grid documents its `#uid.sgs-feature-grid` "intentionally beats the wrapper's `.uid` rules" (D270 composite-override) — a real need, but achievable at `.uid.block` (0,2,0 > the wrapper's 0,1,0) WITHOUT an ID; the others cite anti-collision/safety. **Universalisation:** normalise the 7 from `#uid` → `.uid.block` (class, ≤ the residual's 0,2,0), preserving every override they rely on, so ALL blocks scope at ≤ class-level and the residual (0,2,0, appended last) wins universally — no ID anywhere. Each of the 7 (all landed no-inline blocks) re-verified live after the drop.
- Reconciled FR-31-22.3 (`#{$uid}` → class-level `.{uid}.{block}`; the earlier ID text was aspirational — the reference blocks already emit at class-level). No ID, no `!important` anywhere (§7a anti-cheat clean). Files (planned): `converter/services/styling_helpers.py` (bounding), `includes/custom-css.php` (specificity+order), the ~2 outlier block render.php (normalise), `converter/services/styling_content.py` (M2 lift). qc-council + live LAND (deploy+reclone+purge+3-breakpoint verify) gate the commit.

- **Decision — placement + always-on**: gate runs PRE-deploy (a mirror-cheat must halt before going live) and in ALL modes (it has no stubbed-signal weakness, so no draft-mode auto-skip). `--skip-stage-gate` is the only escape hatch.

## 2026-06-12 (theme thread) — D217: Spec 30 P2 Step 10b — back-in-stock notify-me capture SHIPPED + live-verified; reusable Cloudflare Turnstile primitive added

**D217 — P-WC-NOTIFY-ME-CAPTURE built, live-verified on the canary, and committed on `feat/spec30-p2-step10`.** Step 10b of `2026-06-11-spec30-p2-differentiators-shop-schema.md`. Bean directed (2026-06-12) "build it now" + "don't go overboard on the legal side — get consent and use Cloudflare Turnstile for spam safety". Result = a **proportionate** capture, NOT a maximalist PII red-team:
- **NEW reusable `SGS\Blocks\Turnstile`** (`includes/class-turnstile.php`) — Cloudflare Turnstile primitive: `Settings → SGS Turnstile` (operator site/secret keys), `enqueue_script()`, `widget_html()`, server `verify()` (siteverify via `wp_remote_post`). **Graceful skip when unconfigured** (verify→true, widget→''); the rate-limit is then the sole guard. Net-new — Turnstile did NOT previously exist anywhere in theme/plugin/forms-engine (Bean believed it did; surfaced + built). Reusable by the SGS forms engine later (currently has no bot protection).
- **NEW `SGS\Blocks\Stock_Notify`** (`includes/class-stock-notify.php` + `stock-notify-admin.php`) — public `POST /sgs/v1/notify/subscribe`, mirrors `class-demand-analytics.php`. Fail-fast chain (live-verified order): **nonce(403) → consent strict-`true`(400) → is_email(400) → published-product/IDOR(404) → rate-limit 5/IP/hr(429) → Turnstile::verify(403) → store(200)**. Rate-limit is BEFORE Turnstile (the external siteverify) so spam can't amplify outbound CF calls; cheap validations stay first so a fat-fingered email isn't counted. Stores ONLY `{email, ts}` in `_sgs_stock_notify` post-meta, dedup by email, cap 1000; raw IP NEVER stored (SHA-256+salt transient key only). `manage_woocommerce`-gated read-only admin meta-box, all values `esc_html`.
- **buybox UI** — notify form rendered inside the existing `sgs/product-card` Interactivity wrapper, shown ONLY out-of-stock via `data-wp-bind--hidden="context.inStock"` (a pure READ of existing context — zero new store actions/state). Un-ticked + `required` consent checkbox + privacy-policy link (`get_privacy_policy_url()` guarded). Submit handled by a self-contained `notify-view.js` ES module (no Interactivity import, status via `textContent` only, X-WP-Nonce header, resets Turnstile on error). `notifyEnabled` attr (default true); `notifyMeLabel` now LIVE (removed from dead-control baseline → `accepted:[]`). buybox `version` 1.0.4→1.1.0.
- **Live-verified (canary, R-22-11, via curl + guest nonce):** front-page 200 (no fatal); no-nonce→403; consent=false→400; bad email→400; draft 1017→404; bogus id→404; valid→200 + `{email,ts}` stored; dedup (resend stored once); rate-limit 6th well-formed→429; Turnstile always-fail-secret→403, empty-token-while-configured→403 (fail-closed), always-pass-secret→200; PDP DOM shows the form hidden-when-in-stock with consent `required`/un-checked + privacy link + Turnstile widget + `notify-view.js` enqueued. Canary restored clean (keys emptied, test meta deleted, RL cleared, one-shot removed). QC = inline security review + cross-family haiku rater (all controls PASS). **Operator action for go-live: paste real Cloudflare Turnstile keys** (FR-30-13 checklist item). Memory: proportionate-consent-plus-turnstile over PII-red-team-theatre.

## 2026-06-11 (theme thread) — D213: Spec 30 P2 Gate A + Gate B SHIPPED + merged to main; shop archive built on WC's canonical Product Collection + Filters structure

Fixed by matching WC's canonical collection markup → instant filtering verified live (5→3 products in 253ms, no reload). ## 2026-06-09 (cloning thread) — Wave-2 clone-fix: 8-family diagnosis → 2 councils → build plan → Stage 0; 3 FRs ratified + conformance gate (D193)

**D183 — A new fidelity verifier `parity2` replaces the three over-reporting instruments (pixel-diff, old clone-parity, leftover-buckets). The DRAFT is the 100% denominator; it measures CONTENT + LAYOUT + CSS transfer, class-AGNOSTIC.** _(Commits `2ddea70b`/`a2336198`/`486f8f9f`. Built via `/dispatching-parallel-agents` + `/qc`. Design: `.claude/reports/2026-06-07-draft-centric-parity-verifier-design.md`. Files: `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/parity2/*.py` + `clone-parity.js --dump-captures`.)_

- **Why the old tools failed (all over-report, different ways):** pixel-diff judges painted pixels (photos/sub-pixel noise); old clone-parity pairs by DOM path → rewards a div-by-div MIRROR + penalises genuine conversion; leftover-buckets is a block-SLOT census → flags every slot the draft never set as `extraction_failed` (the perfectly-converted trust-bar logged 48 false failures). stage-2 + extract.json ARE reliable.
- **The model (Bean-directed):** enumerate everything the draft contains = 100%; per draft node find its EQUIVALENT clone node by own-text anchors + Lowest-Common-Ancestor tree-alignment (absorbs renames + WP wrapper divs), class-agnostic; report content/layout/css transfer. Fate-aware (emit-block / lift-attr / fold-parent / chrome via the converter's own DB tables).
- **Key calibrations:** content via word-overlap ≥70% (the `/qc` fix — verbatim containment had false negatives); raw width/height de-weighted (layout CONSEQUENCE); **LAYOUT props scored as a separate WEIGHTED signal** (Bean's catch — they were diluted in the overall css%, hiding the trust-bar's real badge-grid difference). Reports content%/layout%/css%/full%.
- **Validated:** trust-bar content 100% / layout 95% / css 96% / full 93% (QC-verified trustworthy: 4 badges → 4 distinct clone nodes). Honestly surfaces mirrored sections (brand layout 48%). NOT yet wired into `/sgs-clone` (next-session Task 1).

## 2026-06-04 (theme thread, session 11) — Spec 27 Phase-1 hardening: U9 WCAG add-to-cart `<button>` + moat-evidence sheet; U8 cache/tax verified + the M-C1 staleness gap found-and-fixed (D165)

**(1) U9 — WCAG 2.2 AA add-to-cart `<button>` + moat-evidence sheet SHIPPED (`afb7a65a`, FR-27-B1/J1).** The add-to-cart control was an `<a role="button">` — activates on Enter only; Space scrolls the page (a WCAG 2.1.1 failure axe-core does NOT flag, because the ARIA role is valid). Replaced with a native `<button type="submit">` inside a `<form method="post" action="<permalink>">` (both Bound branches): Space AND Enter both fire it; the form is the no-JS fallback (submits to the product page, identical to the old `<a href>`). Bound-branch only — page-144 Typed clones untouched; `.product-card__cart-form{display:contents}` keeps the button the flex item so it renders pixel-identical (full-width). New selectors only. **All 4 objective gates live-verified (isolated Playwright + axe-core node script):** axe-core 0; Space+Enter both fire add-to-cart; ArrowRight moves the radiogroup (+ price reactively swapped to £18.99); Tab reaches the button + exits the card (no trap); 2 `aria-labelledby` radiogroups + 4 `aria-live` regions; all 16 pills + button ≥44px; 0 console errors. Published `.claude/reports/sgs-configurator-moat-evidence.md` (FR-27-J1): each claim + durability rating (WCAG=first-mover, with a 3rd-party-audit-before-public-marketing caveat; availability/secure-cart=feature; no-React=expiring/pending-U10; closed-loop=structural/partial). product-card 1.6.2→1.6.3.

**(2) U8 — cache + tax correctness: the M-C1 staleness gap was REAL (empirically confirmed) and is now CLOSED (FR-27-H3/G6).** Root-cause/evidence-first verification (token-gated webroot runners on the live canary) found the council's #1 real-money risk was NOT actually mitigated: changing a VARIATION's price left the PARENT manifest transient STALE for the whole 24h TTL (UK Consumer Rights Act exposure). Three compounding causes: (a) the purge hooks fire with the VARIATION object → `purge_by_product_id` deleted `sgs_manifest_<variation_id>`, never the parent's `sgs_manifest_<parent_id>`; (b) WooCommerce does NOT bump the PARENT's `post_modified` on a variation-only change → the render-time guard (which compared the parent's `get_date_modified()`) never noticed; (c) the registered price-purge hooks `woocommerce_product_set_price`/`set_sale_price` are effectively NO-OPS (do not fire on a programmatic variation price save — same class of non-existent-hook bug as the `wc_scheduled_sales` one the council caught). **Fix (both deployed + proven):** the render-time staleness guard now keys freshness on `MAX(post_modified_gmt)` across the product AND all its variations (one indexed query, write-path-agnostic — the authoritative M-C1 mechanism), and the purge helper resolves a variation to its PARENT so the right transient is deleted (best-effort latency layer). **Empirically PROVEN on the canary:** pre-fix → STALE; post-fix → FRESH for both a regular-price change and a sale-price change (with a realistic ≥2s gap; the same-second case is a 1-second-resolution residual, far narrower than the original 24h-any-change gap, and backstopped by the parent-save purge). **Tax:** WC tax is DISABLED on the canary, so card==cart is satisfied by construction (both card and cart read WC display pricing); the dual-ex/inc-tax-seed + CDN-vary machinery stays DEFERRED per M-C10 (Mama's is UK B2C tax-inclusive → card==cart by construction there too). **2-rater cross-model review (Sonnet ×2; Gemini/Cerebras unavailable): NO blockers** — applied the LiteSpeed-purge-parent-only refinement; declined the "skip the freshness query" perf nit (the query is required on every path to both validate a hit and stamp `generatedAt` on a rebuild — it IS the M-C1 "one indexed read"; bounded + indexed). ## 2026-06-03 (theme thread) — Global-styles architecture ratified → Spec 26; supersedes D156 framing + flags D18 over-correction (D158)

**D153 — Phase D: converter emits `sgs/option-picker` for draft pill groups (THEME thread; uncommitted).** Three wired parts: **(1) DB** — a `slots` row (via `seed-slot-synonyms.py`) aliases `pill-group`/`pills`/`option-group`/`picker` → `sgs/option-picker` with `has_inner_blocks=0`; a `block_composition` row sets `composition_role=content-block`. **(2) `_atomic_attrs_for` handler** (`convert.py:1656–1745`) — when `slug == 'sgs/option-picker'`, reads child `<li>`/`<label>`/pill elements to populate `optionItems (array of {key,label})`, `defaultSelected`, `typeKey`; returns before the text-fallback path (`allow_text_fallback=False` from G3-attrs caller). **(3) G3-attrs path** (`convert.py:2186–2201`) — an `elif` branch fires when `composition_role='content-block'` and `has_inner_blocks=0`; calls `_atomic_attrs_for(..., allow_text_fallback=False)` so block-specific array handlers fire without the graceful text-fallback corrupting their result. R-22-1 clean (DB-driven G3 gate; no slug literals in the G3 elif). Live-verified emitting `<!-- wp:sgs/option-picker {"optionItems":[…],"defaultSelected":"…","typeKey":"…"} /-->`. Spec 24 FR-24-15; Spec 25 §Clone-emit.

**D156 — WCAG global colour + spacing raw-value defaults (THEME thread; uncommitted).** theme.json `settings.color.custom: true` and `settings.spacing.customSpacingSize: true` — both now enabled. Previously `false`, which prevented editors from entering raw colour hex or raw spacing values and forced them to only use palette/scale presets. Enabling these gates two sub-patterns: **(1) Overridable CSS vars** — product-card and option-picker expose their visual tokens as CSS custom properties (`--sgs-product-card-max-width`, `--sgs-product-card-bg`, `--sgs-product-card-shadow`, `--sgs-op-bg`, `--sgs-op-sel-bg`, `--sgs-op-sel-text`, etc.) on `:root`; style variations override them at the theme level; per-block inspector controls (coming later) override at the instance level. **(2) Framework-default-white + per-client-override pattern** — product-card background defaults `--sgs-product-card-bg: #ffffff` (safe on any palette); selected pill text defaults `--sgs-op-sel-text: #ffffff` (passes 4.5:1 on the framework teal primary `#1F7A7A`; style variations with light primary MUST override `--sgs-op-sel-text` to a dark value — documented in-CSS with example). **(3) Universal auto-contrast DEFERRED** — CSS `color-contrast()` (Level 5) is not yet in stable browsers; `prefers-contrast` media query is coarser than needed. Decision: document the per-client override requirement clearly in the CSS rather than attempt a JS/PHP auto-contrast solution now. Review when `color-contrast()` lands in Baseline.

**D157 — Skip-link theme bug fixed (THEME thread; uncommitted).** Two-part fix: **(1)** Removed the custom `<a class="skip-link">` from `parts/header.html` — WordPress core injects `#wp-skip-link` automatically with `screen-reader-text` handling; the custom element duplicated it and caused two skip links in the DOM. **(2)** Removed a duplicate `.skip-link:focus` rule from `assets/css/header-modes.css` — the canonical show/hide CSS lives in `assets/css/utilities.css` only (`.skip-link:not(.screen-reader-text)` + `:focus`/`:focus-visible` rules). A JS fix in `assets/js/header-behaviour.js` (`moveFocusToMain()`) bridges the WP core skip-link bug where scrolling to `#main` does not move keyboard focus — this remains. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks).

## 2026-06-02 (theme thread) — Product-card Phase C design SIGNED OFF: SGS card is a "wrapper+bridge" over WooCommerce; add-to-cart in scope (D151)

**D151 — Product-card Phase C design ratified (Bean-directed, research-gated 2026-06-02). Refines/reframes D149.** Design gate per the theme next-session-prompt: `/research` (research-pipeline, community-validated — WC source, WP core docs; run file `~/.claude/pipeline-runs/2026-06-02-woocommerce-block-bindings-product-card.md`) + Bean sign-off BEFORE any code. Bean corrected the primary-case framing (the key reframe). _(⚠ Note 2026-06-06: the `sgs/trust-bar` dual-mode / `sourceMode='bound'` ratification in D151 has been re-classified — the converter's bound-emit is a test cheat, not ratified architecture; only the live WC `wc-product`/`sgs-cpt` binding survives. See reports/2026-06-06-doc-council-findings.md.)_

**(1) "Wrapper + bridge" model (Bean's reframe — corrects D149's implied default).** The SGS product-card is ALWAYS the unified authoring wrapper the client uses — same UX whether WooCommerce is present or not. WooCommerce, when present, is the optional BACKING STORE the card bridges to for real commerce data (price/image/stock/cart). D149 framed non-WC as the default and WC as the refinement; Bean clarified the card's WHOLE PURPOSE is being a design+functionality wrapper ON TOP OF WC, so **WC-present is the PRIMARY case**, non-WC (SGS `sgs_product` CPT) is the graceful-degradation superset path. One UX, two backing stores behind one binding source.

**(2) Source = auto-from-picker (Bean Q1).** No explicit WC/CPT toggle the client must understand. In Bound mode the product picker lists BOTH WC products and SGS `sgs_product` entries; the `sourceMode` attr (`wc-product`|`sgs-cpt`) is set automatically from what's picked. (`typed` remains the third mode = current InnerBlocks authoring; explicit-mode branch in render.php, R-22-14 clean — never `empty($content)`.)

**(3) Pills = SGS layer ALWAYS (Bean Q2, = research verdict).** Pack-size/flavour pills always come from the SGS `_sgs_variation_sets` layer + `sgs/option-picker`, even on WC sites; WC supplies base price/image/stock. **WC-native per-variant pricing/stock is a DEFERRED advanced opt-in** (real multi-SKU shops only) — NOT the common path. Research reason: WC deprecated its block-editor variation manager in WC 10.1, so WC-native variations mean the complex classic admin — wrong for tech-illiterate clients; and for typical SGS clients pills are DISPLAY choices, not separate inventory.

**(4) Add-to-cart IS in Phase C (Bean: "you decide" → include).** A shop-wrapper card without add-to-cart is half-built; reuses Task A's just-verified Store-API path (`POST /wc/store/v1/batch` → `wc-blocks_added_to_cart` → `sgs/cart` badge re-fetch). Scope: adds the bound WC product (selected pack-size) via Store API; mapping a pill to a genuine WC variable-product `variation_id` is the deferred advanced path with (3).

**(5) Architecture (research, battle-tested):** single binding source `sgs-product/field` (`uses_context:['postId']`, `source_args.source` routes WC vs CPT; `wc_get_product()->get_price_html()` gives variable-product RANGES "£10–£30" free). Front-end pill→price/image swap via **WP Interactivity API** (`wp_interactivity_state` seeds all variations server-side; `data-wp-on--sgs:option-selected`) — ~12KB, zero jQuery, zero wc-blocks React bundle (card is `sgs/*` not `wc/*`, so WC's heavy bundle never loads on marketing pages). No-JS: render.php always outputs the first variation's concrete price/image.

**GROUND-TRUTH CONTRACT CORRECTION (caught reading source, not the research):** the `sgs/option-picker` event is `sgs:option-selected`, `detail:{ typeKey, selectedKey, contentImpact }` (verified in `option-picker/view.js`) — NOT the `{value,name}` the research example assumed. The build MUST use `selectedKey`/`typeKey`/`contentImpact`. (Memory `read_ground_truth_before_concluding`.)

**Build:** `/subagent-driven-development` (Sonnet implementer + spec + quality reviewers); dispatched agents return uncommitted; main thread builds/deploys/live-verifies/`/qc`-multi-rater/commits. Spec 24 §FR-24-2/3/9 + Phase C amended. Gate that's now CLEARED: Task A (real WC product 513 exists to bind to).

## 2026-06-02 (cloning thread) — container-bearing roster + 3-KIND model + 4-block save-null fix (D150)

**D150 — block_composition container roster validated (28 blocks, 3-KIND role-based model) + 4-block save-null fix SHIPPED. (CLONING thread; branch `feat/block-composition-container-kind` off main @ 3c388195; commits 0c1078cf + d5ebe439.)** Started from D136's "the pipeline doesn't faithfully transfer the draft's CSS" → drilled into which blocks are container-bearing (to propagate a future `contentWidth` capability) + a save-null bug class.

**(1) Container-bearing criterion (5 qc-council rounds; R-22-1 DB-first, no hardcoded block→kind dict).** A block is container-bearing iff it WRAPS CHILDREN — via (a) a real InnerBlocks slot (`save.js`=InnerBlocks.Content / `edit.js` useInnerBlocksProps, often a child-block template), (b) an array-of-OBJECTS content attr (items/images/reviews/…), or (c) a strong layout-orchestration attr (grid columns/gridTemplate/gridItem OR flex direction/justifyContent/wrap OR `layout`; `gap` ALONE does NOT qualify). The earlier "has a layout/section attr" criterion was WRONG — it excluded FR-22-6 InnerBlocks composites like info-box whose content moved from scalar attrs into an InnerBlocks template (Bean caught it). **The council validated whatever criterion it was GIVEN — framing the question around the wrong signal yielded 2 confidently-wrong rounds before Bean's domain knowledge corrected it (new STOP #39).**

**(2) 3-KIND role-based model (drives a sub-typed parity diff so the sync script isn't noisy).** *section* = self-contained panel owning its whole frame (full container attr surface); *layout* = arranges/parents MULTIPLE children — grid/flex OR structural parent like tabs/accordion/form (grid/flex/width/contentWidth subset); *content* = holds ONE unit's content (width/contentWidth/spacing subset). Derivation: section-attr→section; grid/flex-attr OR parents-a-container (allowedBlocks/parent)→layout; single-unit InnerBlocks→content. Two operator overrides via block.json `supports.sgs.containerKind:"section"` (NOT attr-derivable): **trust-bar** (full-bleed wrapper + max-width grid) + **modal** (standalone panel). **Final 28-block roster:** SECTION(4) cta-section/hero/modal/trust-bar; LAYOUT(13) card-grid/feature-grid/gallery/multi-button/post-grid/pricing-table/trustpilot-reviews/google-reviews/form-field-tiles/testimonial-slider/tabs/accordion/form; CONTENT(11) info-box/product-card/testimonial/quote/tab/accordion-item/form-step/notice-banner/option-picker/team-member/mobile-nav.

**(3) save-null gotcha-B4 fix SHIPPED (4 blocks).** feature-grid/multi-button/tab/accordion-item declared `save:()=>null` while using an InnerBlocks slot → WP dropped child blocks from post_content on re-save (render.php got empty `$content`). Each now returns bare `<InnerBlocks.Content/>` (NO wrapper div — render.php already wraps `$content`; D136 leaked-div avoidance) + a `deprecated.js` null-save entry. **mobile-nav EXCLUDED** (Bean: nav fully server-rendered via core/page-list fallback; Zone 6 supplementary; save-null avoids deprecation churn + D143 risk). 5 parallel Sonnet subagents (verify-then-fix); committed `--no-verify` (non-visual). **Pre-deploy /qc (live editor-validation) + merge-to-main PENDING.**

**Workstream A (the block_composition table write — detector rewrite + `container_kind` column + composition_role fixes for post-grid/gallery/card-grid leaf→content-block + populate) is VALIDATED + SPEC'D but NOT built** — deferred to a fresh session per STOP #19. **[SUPERSEDED by D152 — Workstream A SHIPPED commit `0d746073`; see D152 §1.]** Spec: `.claude/scratch/2026-06-02-container-roster-db-table-handoff.md`. **CSS-transfer contentWidth (gaps 1+2, Option B) designed + qc-council-validated + @1440-baseline-measured, NOT built** — `.claude/scratch/2026-06-04-css-transfer-gaps-1-2-fix-shape.md`.

## 2026-06-02 (theme thread) — wave 1–3: option-picker + migrations + mega-menu + design fixes + icon + cart + product-card Phase B (D148) + product-card Phase C dual-source architecture (D149)

**D149 — Product-card data SOURCE is dual-source: WooCommerce-native when present, custom CPT meta otherwise; `custom-fields` is a REST-exposure flag, not a storage choice (Bean-directed 2026-06-02; Phase C design anchor).** Bean questioned why the `sgs_product` CPT carries custom price meta (`sgs_price`) when WooCommerce already models price/image/stock/variations. Resolution clarifies Spec 24's architecture + refines it: (1) **clarification** — the CPT `custom-fields` support I added (D148) is NOT a storage decision; it is the WP gate that makes ANY registered meta visible in the REST API. It is needed for the SGS-specific `_sgs_variation_sets` config (display_as/content_impact — which WC does not model) regardless of price source. (2) **architecture (correct, per Spec 24 "Out of scope" + Bean's refinement)** — framework DEFAULT remains the lightweight `sgs_product` CPT (most SGS clients are marketing sites with no shop; never force WooCommerce). But when a site HAS WooCommerce, the card should **bind to WC-native product data** (price/image/stock/variations) rather than duplicate it as custom fields (two-sources-of-truth for price = sync nightmare). (3) **Phase C shape = dual-source binding** — WC present → read WC product data; no WC → read `sgs_product` custom fields; SGS-specific config (variation-sets display) → always custom meta. commit `ee6807d3`); `sgs/notice-banner` FR-22-6 InnerBlocks migration (`d8c30a74`, mirrors info-box v4); mega-menu generic layout pattern library (7 patterns + `mega-menu-layouts` category + orphan-part register + create-panel shortcut; ## 2026-05-31 — FR-22-4.1 Universal wrapper/container resolution (D118)

**D118 — §FR-22-4.1 "Universal wrapper/container resolution" added to Spec 22 as the canonical single rule for every sgs-classed wrapper the walker meets below a section root (Bean-directed 2026-05-31). Supersedes the patchwork: `walk_passthrough` drop-and-bubble for sgs-classed nodes, the depth-2 `_is_layout_bearing_wrapper` gate, and `_absorb_transparent_wrappers` (D52). Closes the FR-22-4 refinement mandate from D109.**

Four-step precedence (§FR-22-4.1):

1. **Block match wins** — BEM class resolves to a registered block → emit that block; it owns its CSS.
2. **Direct descendant + no block match → FOLD into parent container** — 1-child or non-layout shell: CSS folds as inner-CSS layer. Grid/flex direct child: container absorbs layout (`gridTemplateColumns`, `gap`, …); each resulting direct-item's positioning CSS folds as grid-item attrs on the container.
3. **Exception to #2 — direct descendant whose class matches a block → emit as that block** (it IS the grid item; handles its own CSS).
4. **Non-direct-descendant (nested below a folded wrapper) → its own sgs/container** (NEVER dropped); its descendants then recurse through #1–#3.

**What this supersedes:** the three patchwork mechanisms were each partial/overlapping implementations of the same principle — merge transparent direct-child shells, preserve genuine nested structures. §FR-22-4.1 unifies them into one coherent rule. `walk_passthrough`'s drop-and-bubble applied to non-sgs nodes only (FR-22-11) — its sgs-classed analogue is now §FR-22-4.1. The depth-2 `_is_layout_bearing_wrapper` gate (D117 G2) was the empirical discovery that led to this formalisation. `_absorb_transparent_wrappers` (D52 merge-side pre-pass) is folded in as rule #2's 1-child case.

**FR-22-11 scope clarification:** FR-22-11 governs nodes with NO sgs- classes (transparent non-SGS wrappers) — unchanged. §FR-22-4.1 governs nodes WITH sgs- classes that do not resolve to a registered block.

**Propagated to:** Spec 22 §FR-22-3 deferred-trigger note, §FR-22-11, §FR-22-17; Spec 00 §3.2; cloning-pipeline-flow.md Universal-path topology section; cloning-pipeline-stages.md Stage 4 annotation; TRUTH-SPEC.md trust-bar + featured-product worked examples; parking.md P-XS-3-TRIGGER-REFINEMENT + P-UNIFY-CONTAINER-ABSORPTION + P-CONVERTER-CONTENT-ROUTING-FIX + P-FR226-FIDELITY-AND-MERGE.

R-22 compliance: R-22-3 (remains FR-22-4 refinement, NOT a 4th walker branch), R-22-9 (universal — same rule for every wrapper, no per-class special-casing), R-22-11 (live-DOM verification gate), R-22-13 (Bean sign-off co-authoritative).

**D117 — FR-22-2 leaf content-routing (G1) + FR-23-6 depth-2 grid-wrapper preservation (G2) shipped on `feat/fr22-6-content-render` (commit 1fcb0742). Mama's page 144 now renders its content AND side-by-side card layout — verified on the LIVE DOM, not pixel-diff.** Sequence: D116's container migrations were necessary-but-insufficient (content stayed empty). Root cause = the universal walker never ran FR-22-2 content-routing for leaf blocks.

- **G1 (leaf content-routing):** `walk()` lifts a leaf block's rich text into its content attr via `_atomic_attrs_for` + suppresses child recursion for leaves. ALSO fixed a latent bug: `_atomic_attrs_for`'s graceful fallback checked `info.get("type")` but `block_attrs()` returns the type under `attr_type` → the fallback NEVER fired (only explicit slug handlers worked). Result (live DOM): featured-product 0→510 chars, social-proof →621, trust-bar →98; all 7 content sections render. 4 regression tests (`tests/test_g1_leaf_lift.py`).
- **G2 (FR-23-6 depth-2 grid-wrapper preservation):** designed via a **3-rater council** (pipeline-forensics + code-path-tracer + live-CSS — all converged) reading the full Spec 20/21 log set + code. `_is_layout_bearing_wrapper` Trigger A preserves a slug-None wrapper as a neutral className-only `sgs/container` when **depth≥2 AND display:grid/flex AND ≥2 children resolve to real block slugs**. The depth gate (trace-confirmed: depth-1 `__inner`/`__content` wrappers over-fire + double-nest; depth-2 grid wrappers are the genuine layout rows) is the missing signal FR-23-6 always specified ("fire through `__inner` passthrough, targets at depth-2"). Result (live DOM + screenshot): featured-product + gift cards SIDE-BY-SIDE; header/trust-bar/brand back to 1 container (**duplicate nesting fixed**); brand −11.1; mean −0.66pp net win. Two earlier attempts (leaf-misresolution guard → hero regress; grid/flex-any-depth → over-fire) reverted per STOP #19 before this landed.
- **Methodology lesson (false-pixel-diff, BOTH directions):** an EMPTY section scores a false WIN on cropped pixel-diff (matches background); a REFLOWED-to-correct section (cards side-by-side) scores a false LOSS (differs from the stacked baseline crop). Pixel-diff mis-scores exactly the structural changes that matter. Live-DOM `textLen` + element-layout checks (Playwright) are the authoritative gate. Captured: memory `empty-section-false-pixel-diff-win`.
- **Status:** WIP on branch (renders correctly, NOT yet pixel-acceptance — images dry-run, `sgs/info-box` hybrid, exact styling). Merges to main when fidelity reaches the acceptance threshold. block_composition role corrections shipped via idempotent `seed-composition-roles.py` (testimonial+slider leaf→content-block, label→leaf).

## 2026-06-08/09 — HC2 dead-control cleanup + build-time guard (D192)

- **D192 — Library-wide DEAD CONTROL purge + structural guard SHIPPED (commit `6922e541`, pushed; canary-verified).** An editor control whose attr is never consumed in render = a setting a client changes that does NOTHING (FR-22-6/native-supports migration debt). Audit (`.claude/reports/wave2/HC2-dead-control-library-audit.md`) found 34; the new guard surfaced ~39 more → ~73 handled (~60 removed, ~13 wired/confirmed-live). Full record: `.claude/reports/wave2/HC2-COMPLETION-2026-06-09.md`.
  - **Governing rule (locked):** a parent composite owns STRUCTURE (layout, wrapper, background, gap); the child text blocks (`sgs/heading`/`sgs/text`/`sgs/label`) own CONTENT + TYPOGRAPHY across ALL breakpoints. A parent control duplicating a child capability is BOTH a forbidden duplicate AND usually **dead by CSS specificity** — a parent scoped rule `.{uid} .sgs-hero__headline{color}` (0,2,0) cannot beat the child's inline style (1,0,0,0), so "wiring" it would ship a control that looks live but paints nothing. Removed hero's 22 typography attrs + all headline/sub-headline/label font-size groups; cta-section body + testimonial name font-size groups (child owns sizing); info-box colour/icon/legacy-link; testimonial(-slider) colours; form-field-file maxFiles + form-field-address lookupProvider (unbuilt); the shared dead `ContentSpacingPanel` innerPadding (product-card keeps a bespoke one); feature-grid columnsDesktop schema bug; ~20 orphans + 2 vestigial destructures. Wired where the parent IS the natural home: post-grid hover, google-reviews breakdown, mobile-nav social size, hero text-align + CTA gap.
  - **Guard `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/check-dead-controls.js`** (Rule-10 structural defence): fails `npm run build`/`start` (prebuild `--check`) on any new controlled-but-unrendered attr; DB-260 compliant (consumed/extension sets derived from source); empty baseline = zero tolerance. Two cross-block channels handled: responsive `{base}Tablet/Mobile` (consumed if base consumed + breakpoint token IN THE BLOCK'S OWN corpus) and `providesContext`→live-`usesContext`. Corpus is block-local + shared `includes/` ONLY — deliberately NOT broadened to all blocks (generic names `title`×91/`label`×74 would collide and re-open the bug class). Proven to fail on a reintroduced (incl. `sgs`-prefixed) dead control and pass clean across 69 blocks.
  - **Validation:** `/qc-council` overturned 2 of my calls (hero typography WIRE→REMOVE on the specificity proof; innerPadding WIRE→remove-panel) + tightened the guard rules. `/adversarial-council` (6 personas) graded the cleanup A−/A (converter-safe per the live trace; deprecations sound) but found 3 real guard false-negatives (rule (a) neutered by shared-corpus `@media` pollution; regex blind to `update('k',v)` + `RRangeControl attrDesktop=` controls; `sgs*` prefix bypass) + a commit-safety trap (untracked guard files) — ALL fixed + re-proven before commit. Commit was path-scoped (50 explicit paths; co-active Spec-28/cloning files excluded); `--no-verify` used (hook-sanctioned for non-visual change). `/sgs-update` pruned 86 orphan DB attrs to match the slimmed schemas.
  - **Scope note:** the guard is build-gated (runs on every `npm run build`/`start` = the deploy path); a CI/pre-commit/self-test backstop was considered and deliberately NOT pursued (no CI exists; over-engineering for now). No client inspector-notice added — the typography capability was always on the child block; the removed parent controls were dead, so there is no functional loss to bridge.
  - Memory: `dead-control-can-be-dead-by-specificity`. R-22 compliance: R-22-9 (universal — every block, no carve-out), R-22-11 (live-DOM canary verify), R-22-13 (Bean eye co-authoritative — screenshot delivered).

### D230 — Exact-match width model: widthMode RETIRED → 3 independent layers (align / maxWidth / contentWidth); Bean-locked, council-gated, LANDED-verified 2026-06-18

A Bean-initiated **architectural design upgrade** (NOT part of the D229 Phase-F plan, but NOT a spot-fix either — Bean-clarified 2026-06-18: a spot-fix is a means-to-an-end score/section-chase that ignores pipeline-wide implications; this is a deliberate, universal 3-layer width-model upgrade considering overall implications, so it does NOT conflict with D229's no-spot-fix principle — it's an architectural primitive the clean rebuild builds ON) to make cloned section widths render EXACTLY like the draft. Designed via `/brainstorming` → `/adversarial-council` (6-persona, caught a fatal `maxWidth`-is-occupied premise error pre-build) → Bean design-gate (4 iterations) → SDD build (subagents implement, Opus orchestrates) → `/qc-council` (3-rater, caught a real responsive-specificity WRITTEN-not-LANDED bug pre-commit) → live computed-style verify on the canary. Design doc: `.claude/plans/2026-06-17-exact-match-width-model-design.md` (v0.4).

**The model (replaces the old `widthMode` outer-width system):**
- **`align`** (WP-native, `supports.align:['wide','full']`) = breakout (full-bleed/wide). Converter emits `align:"full"` for a full-bleed section (was `widthMode:"full"`).
- **`maxWidth`** (string literal) = OUTER box cap, exact draft value (decimals+unit preserved; the 5% theme-snap + `int()` truncation are GONE). Responsive `maxWidthTablet/Mobile` via the wrapper's 767/1023 device tiers (base deferred to a `.uid` rule when tiers exist, so `@media` wins — the specificity fix).
- **`contentWidth`** (token OR literal) = INNER band. Tokens RENAMED: `narrow`=content-size(~780), `default`=wide-size(~1200, the new default value), `full`=no cap. Base sanitiser unified onto `$sgs_css_length`. Converter emits `contentWidth:"full"` for a slug-None section with no detected band (fidelity — no imposed 1200 default).

**Retired:** `widthMode`/`widthModeMobile/Tablet/Desktop` + `customWidth`/`customWidthUnit` (theme NOT live → deleted outright, no deprecation). Editor controls now `UnitControl`-style (number+unit) like gap/font-size; breakout via WP's native align toolbar. `sgs/quote` bespoke customWidth control migrated to the shared control. 6 conformance goldens rebaselined (`widthMode:"full"`→`align:"full"` only — verified no other drift). **Deferred cosmetic sweep:** ~30 vestigial `widthMode` block.json declarations + 8 stale render.php doc-comments (harmless, declared-but-unread). **LANDED-verified:** all 7 live render cases correct on the canary (align breakout, maxWidth literal, contentWidth narrow/default/full/literal). WP best-practice confirmed via `/library-docs` (no native max-width support → custom attr is correct). **D-CEILING now D230.**

### D231 — Content-band token rename (normal/wide/full, default=full) + widthMode vestigial sweep; Bean-locked, LANDED 2026-06-18

Follow-up to D230 after the live theme revealed content-size=1200 / wide-size=1400 (not the assumed 780/1200), making the `narrow`/`default` labels wrong. **New `contentWidth` model:** `normal`→content-size(1200), `wide`→wide-size(1400), `full`→no cap, or a literal. **Default value `"default"`→`"full"`** — a blank/defaulted contentWidth imposes NO inner band (content fills the outer `maxWidth`); this also resolves the D230 outer-800+1200-band nuance. Conformance 43+41, build green (dead-control 0 net-new). **D-CEILING now D231.**

### D232 — Phase-F step F2 SHIPPED: draft-derived CSS Accounting Ledger input parser; physical-only (no expansion); Bean-locked, council+cross-model gated 2026-06-18

The keystone of the Spec-31 §12.7 clean-rebuild Tier-1 foundation (MF-1). A standalone module `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/ledger/{declare_input,models}.py` does an INDEPENDENT tinycss2 parse of a draft's raw HTML+CSS into a surjective `declare_input` set `(selector,property,value,media,tier,source_index,…)` at Stage 0.7 BEFORE any routing — never imports css_router/convert/db_lookup, never queries the DB (STOP-3), so it cannot inherit the converter's blind spots. FAIL-CLOSED: parse error / unknown at-rule / non-font @import / blockless @media / at-rule-in-decl-list all raise `LedgerParseError` — zero silent skips. Captures pseudo-elements, inline `style=""`, custom-props, `!important`, @media tiers. Tier = canonical device thresholds {767/768, 1023/1024, 1024} ONLY; 600/640/781 → `Other:<verbatim>` (D228 device-tier-vs-visual lock; the rt-media-600 CHEAT). 37 fixtures, 515 declarations, 167 tests; deterministic `--check` wired into `package.json prebuild` (not inert). Commit `f8a746c7`.
**Architecture decision (Bean's catch):** F2 does NO shorthand expansion. The DB already owns box-model shorthand→longhand decomposition (`property_suffixes` shorthand+longhand rows + `modifier_suffixes` side/corner) — rebuilding it violates R-22-1, and sourcing expansion FROM the DB would make the ledger circular (STOP-3). So F2 records physical declarations only; partial-shorthand-lift detection is F3's (render-oracle) job. The whole-declaration guarantee (F2) + within-declaration guarantee (F3) compose to the full no-silent-drop spine. This SUPERSEDED the adversarial-council's value-vs-names shorthand debate.
**Process:** brainstorming → 6-persona adversarial-council → Bean design-gate → SDD build → cross-model code review (caught 3 silent-drop holes — empty-value `continue`, nested @supports overwrite, at-rule-in-decl-list `continue` — all fixed pre-commit) → independent verify. Design doc: `.claude/plans/2026-06-18-f2-css-accounting-ledger-design.md` (v2). **STOP-11 correction:** the doc/expected.md "~15 no-suffix-row properties" list is partly STALE — `background-image`/`object-fit`/`opacity`/`aspect-ratio`/`filter` already have `property_suffixes` rows; F2's baseline is measured against the LIVE DB, never the doc. **F2↔F5 join contract FROZEN** (§9): join key `(selector,property,media)`, value compared-not-joined, non-shadowed non-excluded physical rows = the UNACCOUNTED denominator. **NEXT: F3** (differential render-oracle + 3 metamorphic relations). **D-CEILING now D232.**

### D233 — Phase-F F3 re-scoped to F3-core (computed-style-primary LANDED oracle); F3-runtime deferred; render-mechanism fixed. Council-corrected + Bean-approved 2026-06-18

F3 (the differential render-oracle) was designed → 6-persona adversarial-council → Bean gate. The council found F3-as-designed had a FATAL flaw + was over-scoped; Bean approved a re-scope. Design doc: `.claude/plans/2026-06-18-f3-render-oracle-design.md` (v2). NOT yet built — to build in a fresh session.
**Fatal flaw fixed:** the original "render bare draft locally + pixel-diff vs WP-rendered clone" is apples-to-oranges (draft has no theme CSS/fonts/WP resets → even a perfect transfer fails the pixel-diff on chrome → ~100% false-fails). **Corrected:** the PRIMARY LANDED signal is targeted computed-style on the rendered SGS block (environment-comparable); pixel-diff demoted to a deferred secondary against a known-difference baseline. **parity2 must NOT be the LANDED comparator** — it pairs by draft BEM class which native clone output doesn't carry (memory `parity-bem-class-blind-spot`); reuse only its tolerance helpers, pair by rendered block slug + getComputedStyle.
**Re-scope (reverses the earlier "full render-diff on all 37" call, on new info):** F3-CORE (build now, ~2hrs) = the verdict function + 4 false-win guards (empty/element/non-default/NEW height-parity) + MR-2 (name-free routing) proven on ONE fixture, emitting the frozen F3→F5 contract, computed-style primary. F3-RUNTIME (deferred, build lazily when the rebuild first renders many fixtures) = full-37 canary render-diff + content-hash cache (poison-proof key spec'd) + pixel-diff secondary (apples-to-apples fixed) + flake-classification + deploy choreography + committed per-cell baseline (the F2-golden-regen defence) + canary health-gate. Reasoning: building a cache/orchestration for a render loop that doesn't run yet, where a stale cache = a false LANDED, is the stall trap on a 5-times-failed rebuild.
**Folded council fixes:** exhaustive verdict taxonomy with precedence (NOT-RENDERED>GUARD-FAIL>UNVERIFIED>WRITTEN-not-LANDED>LANDED); section_id via `data-f3-section-id` + converter section→slug map; guard-3 default from block.json not the converter DB (independence); F3→F5 join key `(section_id,block_slug,property,tier)` with F2's tier vocabulary; MR-3 re-scoped (raw-px only, re-snap tokens, never scale breakpoints). **NEXT SESSION: build F3-core.** **D-CEILING now D233.**

### D234 — Phase-F step F3-core SHIPPED: the LANDED render-oracle verdict engine + live-canary proof; Bean-built, cross-model+qc-council gated 2026-06-18

The closing-gate ENGINE of the Spec-31 §12.7 Tier-1 foundation (MF-2/MF-3): proves a CSS value the converter WROTE actually LANDED on the rendered SGS block (catches WRITTEN-not-LANDED / wrong-layer transfer in the oracle, not Bean's eye — STOP-4). New module `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/oracle/` (sibling of `ledger/`), commit `6b430dae`:

- **guards.py** — 4 false-win guards: empty-section (`innerText.length>0`+present), element-present (slug selector), non-default-value (cell-level, sourced from **block.json default** not converter DB — independence; draft==default → UNVERIFIED), height-parity (relative-OR-absolute, unmeasured→not-confirmed-not-fail).
- **models.py** — FROZEN F3→F5 §6 contract (join key `(section_id,block_slug,property,tier)`; F2 tier vocabulary exactly); `written` precondition (F3 only evaluates converter-written cells — no coincidental-initial-value LANDED, no CSS-initial table); tier-format validation.
- **metamorphic.py** — MR-2 name-free routing (BEM-synonym rename within same slot → JSON-semantically identical AND golden-correct converter output) + coverage line. MR-1/MR-3 → F3-runtime.
- **capture.py** — live-probe interface; `NotImplementedError` stub (F3-runtime wires the automated probe — no fake LANDED).

+ `cluster-member-sets.json` (text/fill/layout member sets sourced from the golden-master registry, not a
